1	"""Checker (code only): proves a finished launch works (SPEC §6).
2	
3	Checks: site points to the server (asked of the AUTHORITATIVE nameservers via
4	`integ.dns`), site opens over HTTPS with a valid certificate, email settings
5	(MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC of the domain the order mailbox is on, compared with the
6	mail provider table; read-only), and a real test order arrives. Each result is
7	stored as a CheckResult row and an AuditEvent. Launch steps are not a check:
8	the report shows them separately.
9	"""
10	
11	import json
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from datetime import timedelta
14	from urllib.parse import urljoin
15	
16	from sqlmodel import Session, select
17	
18	from app import audit, proof
19	from app.agents.executor import Ctx
20	from app.agents.planner import DKIM_PENDING
21	from app.agents.reader import Profile
22	from app.checks.dns_resolver import lookup
23	from app.mail.providers import provider_for
24	from app.models import CheckResult, CheckRun, Order, Outbox, utcnow
25	from app.sites.orders import order_recipients
26	
27	
28	@dataclass
29	class Outcome:
30	    check: str
31	    passed: bool
32	    plain: str  # one line for the seller
33	    detail: str = ""  # technical
34	    waiting: bool = False  # passed as far as we can see, but delivery still needs the owner's "Yes, I got it"
35	    unfinished: bool = False  # we couldn't complete it (our lookup failed, or time ran out): not passed, not her fault
36	    keeps_breaking: bool = False  # fixed several times today and broken again: automatic fixing has stopped
37	
38	
39	class CouldntCheck(Exception):
40	    """Something on OUR side failed, so the check has no answer. Never a failure of the shop."""
41	
42	
43	OUR_SIDE = ("We couldn't look this up just now. The problem is on our side, not yours, and nothing about your shop has "
44	            "changed. We'll check again on the next round.")
45	OUT_OF_TIME = "This check couldn't finish in time, so we don't know yet. We'll try again on the next round."
46	
47	
48	def dns_values(ctx: Ctx, name: str, rtype: str) -> list[str]:
49	    """One DNS answer for a check. A lookup that failed on our side raises, so it can't be read as "missing"."""
50	    got = lookup(ctx.integ.dns, name, rtype)
51	    if got.status == "error":
52	        raise CouldntCheck(f"{rtype} {name}: our lookup failed")
53	    return list(got.values)
54	
55	
56	def practice_world(ctx: Ctx) -> bool:
57	    return bool(ctx.integ.fake or ctx.business.practice)
58	
59	
60	def evidence(ctx: Ctx, check: str, step: str, **fields) -> None:
61	    if ctx.abandoned:  # S13 B: the watchdog gave up on this check; its late answers aren't proof of this run
62	        return
63	    proof.add(ctx.session, business=ctx.business, run_id=ctx.run_id, check=check, step=step,
64	              practice=practice_world(ctx), **fields)
65	
66	
67	def dns_server(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
68	    return getattr(ctx.integ.dns, "last_server", "") or ("pretend nameserver" if ctx.integ.fake else "")
69	
70	
71	def shop_web(ctx: Ctx) -> proof.ShopWeb:
72	    """How the checker reaches the shop like a customer: in-process for practice, else over the internet
73	    to the shop's own host only (SSRF-guarded)."""
74	    factory = getattr(ctx.integ, "shop_web", None)
75	    if factory is not None:
76	        return factory(ctx)
77	    if practice_world(ctx):
78	        return proof.PracticeShopWeb(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.integ.mailer, ctx.business, ctx.plan.site_host)
79	    return proof.real_shop_web(ctx.plan.site_host)
80	
81	
82	def _txt(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
83	    return [v.strip('"') for v in values]
84	
85	
86	def check_site_points(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
87	    host, want = ctx.plan.site_host, ctx.settings.server_ip
88	    got = dns_values(ctx, host, "A")
89	    ok = want in got
90	    evidence(ctx, "site_points", "dns_answer", answer=f"A {host} = {', '.join(got) or 'nothing'}",
91	             server=dns_server(ctx), source="authoritative nameserver")
92	    return Outcome("site_points", ok, "Your address leads to your website." if ok else
93	                   "Your address doesn't lead to your website yet.", f"A {host} = {got or 'nothing'}; want {want}")
94	
95	
96	def public_resolvers_text(want: str, seen: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> str:
97	    """`seen` = [(label, Answer)]. "Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers" (+ who differs, plainly) | the answers."""
98	    agree = [label for label, a in seen if a.status == "ok" and want in a.values]
99	    head = f"Reachable from {len(agree)} of {len(seen)} public resolvers"
100	    odd = []
101	    for label, a in seen:
102	        if label in agree:
103	            continue
104	        name = label.split(" ")[-2]  # "Quad9 9.9.9.9" or "pretend Quad9 9.9.9.9" -> "Quad9"
105	        odd.append(f"{name} didn't answer us" if a.status == "error" else
106	                   f"{name} has no address for it yet" if not a.values else f"{name} still shows an old address")
107	    if odd:
108	        head += f" ({'; '.join(odd)}: this usually clears by itself within hours; no alert for this)"
109	    answers = "; ".join(f"{label}: {', '.join(a.values) or ('no answer' if a.status == 'error' else 'nothing')}"
110	                        for label, a in seen)
111	    return f"{head} | {answers}"
112	
113	
114	def public_resolvers(session: Session, business, run_id: int, host: str, want: str, integ) -> dict | None:
115	    """S13b, the daily run only: ask 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1 and 9.9.9.9 for the shop's address and save what they say
116	    through `proof.add`. Information only: the shop's own nameservers (check_site_points) stay the proof and the only
117	    thing that can fail or alert; a public resolver that disagrees is shown plainly, never alerted on."""
118	    factory = getattr(integ, "public_dns", None)
119	    if factory is None:
120	        return None
121	    seen = [(label, lookup(resolver, host, "A")) for label, resolver in factory()]
122	    if not seen:
123	        return None
124	    text = public_resolvers_text(want, seen)
125	    proof.add(session, business=business, run_id=run_id, check="site_points", step="public_resolvers",
126	              practice=bool(integ.fake or business.practice), answer=text[:500],
127	              server=", ".join(label for label, _a in seen),
128	              source="pretend public resolvers" if integ.fake else "public resolvers")
129	    session.commit()
130	    agree = sum(1 for _label, a in seen if a.status == "ok" and want in a.values)
131	    return {"agree": agree, "asked": len(seen), "text": text}
132	
133	
134	HTTPS_BACKOFF = (5, 10, 20, 40, 45)  # seconds: up to 2 minutes while a new certificate is being issued
135	
136	
137	def check_https(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
138	    url = f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/"
139	    for i in range(len(HTTPS_BACKOFF) + 1):
140	        r = ctx.integ.http.fetch(url)
141	        if r.ok and r.cert_valid:
142	            break
143	        if i < len(HTTPS_BACKOFF):
144	            ctx.integ.sleep(HTTPS_BACKOFF[i])
145	    ok = r.ok and r.cert_valid
146	    detail = f"status={r.status} cert_valid={r.cert_valid} {r.error}".strip()
147	    if not ok:
148	        plain = ("Your website's security certificate isn't working yet." if not r.cert_valid else
149	                 "Your website didn't open.")
150	        return Outcome("https", False, plain, detail)
151	    page = shop_web(ctx).get(url)
152	    if proof.marker(ctx.business) not in page.html:  # a parked page with a valid certificate is not her shop
153	        return Outcome("https", False, "Your address opens a page, but it isn't your shop.",
154	                       f"{detail}; shop marker missing (page status {page.status})")
155	    cert_end = ctx.integ.http.cert_expires(ctx.plan.site_host)
156	    evidence(ctx, "https", "http_response", status_code=r.status, cert_not_after=cert_end, server=page.server,
157	             source=url, answer="shop page with its lw-shop marker")
158	    return Outcome("https", True, "Your website opens securely (the padlock shows).", detail)
159	
160	
161	def mail_zone(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
162	    """The domain whose mail settings matter for this shop's orders: the seller's own domain on
163	    an own-name launch, else the domain the order mailbox is on (the app's)."""
164	    return ctx.plan.zone if ctx.plan.mode == "full" else ctx.plan.mailbox.rsplit("@", 1)[-1].lower()
165	
166	
167	def check_email_mx(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
168	    zone, provider = mail_zone(ctx), provider_for(ctx.settings)
169	    got = dns_values(ctx, zone, "MX")
170	    hosts = {v.split()[-1].rstrip(".").lower() for v in got}
171	    ok = all(h in hosts for _, h in provider.mx)
172	    return Outcome("email_mx", ok, "Emails to your address reach your mailbox." if ok else
173	                   "Emails sent to your address can't reach your mailbox.",
174	                   f"MX {zone} = {got or 'nothing'}; expected {provider.label}")
175	
176	
177	def check_email_spf(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
178	    zone, provider = mail_zone(ctx), provider_for(ctx.settings)
179	    got = _txt(dns_values(ctx, zone, "TXT"))
180	    ok = any(v.startswith("v=spf1") and provider.spf_include in v for v in got)
181	    return Outcome("email_spf", ok, "Your mailbox is allowed to send email for you." if ok else
182	                   "Your emails may land in spam: the sending permission is missing.",
183	                   f"TXT {zone} = {got or 'nothing'}; expected {provider.spf_include}")
184	
185	
186	def dkim_names(ctx: Ctx, zone: str) -> list[str]:
187	    """Signing record names: the ones this launch planned, else whatever the live zone has."""
188	    names = [c["name"] for c in ctx.changes if c["name"].endswith("._domainkey")]
189	    if not names:
190	        try:
191	            names = sorted({r["name"] for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(zone) if r["name"].endswith("._domainkey")})
192	        except Exception:  # can't list the zone (not ours): fall back to the provider's usual names
193	            names = []
194	    return names or [f"{sel}._domainkey" for sel in provider_for(ctx.settings).dkim_selectors]
195	
196	
197	def check_email_dkim(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
198	    zone = mail_zone(ctx)
199	    names, seen = dkim_names(ctx, zone), {}
200	    for name in names:
201	        txt = _txt(dns_values(ctx, f"{name}.{zone}", "TXT"))
202	        seen[name] = (any(v.startswith("v=DKIM1") and "p=" in v for v in txt)
203	                      or bool(dns_values(ctx, f"{name}.{zone}", "CNAME")))
204	    ok = bool(seen) and all(seen.values())
205	    return Outcome("email_dkim", ok, "Your emails are signed so customers can trust them." if ok else
206	                   "Your emails aren't signed, so they may land in spam.",
207	                   f"signing records on {zone}: {seen or 'none found'}")
208	
209	
210	def check_email_dmarc(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
211	    zone = mail_zone(ctx)
212	    got = _txt(dns_values(ctx, f"_dmarc.{zone}", "TXT"))
213	    ok = any(v.startswith("v=DMARC1") for v in got)
214	    return Outcome("email_dmarc", ok, "Fake emails in your name will be treated as spam." if ok else
215	                   "Order emails could land in spam: a protection setting is missing.",
216	                   f"TXT _dmarc.{zone} = {got or 'nothing'}")
217	
218	
219	TEST_CUSTOMER = {"customer_name": "LaunchWitness test", "customer_phone": "0000000000",
220	                 "note": "Automatic test order from your launch check. No action needed."}
221	
222	
223	def check_test_order(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
224	    """Order from the shop like a customer: open the public page, find the order form, post it with a
225	    one-time test code, then record each hop separately. Delivery is proven only by finding the email in
226	    an inbox we can read, or by the owner tapping "Yes, I got it"; a mail server's "accepted" is not delivery."""
227	    url = f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/"
228	    web = shop_web(ctx)
229	    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(ctx.business.profile_json)
230	    page = web.get(url)
231	    form = proof.find_order_form(page.html) if page.status == 200 else None
232	    if form is None:
233	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't open your order form for a test order.",
234	                       f"GET {url}: status {page.status} {page.error}".strip())
235	    index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(profile.products) if not x.addon), 0)
236	    field = f"qty_{index}"
237	    if field not in form.qty_fields:
238	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't find an item to order on your page.", f"{field} not in form")
239	    ticket = proof.new_ticket(ctx.session, ctx.business, ctx.run_id)
240	    started = utcnow()
241	    fields = {**form.hidden, **TEST_CUSTOMER, field: "1", "lw_test": ticket.nonce}
242	    sent = web.post(urljoin(url, form.action), fields)
243	    ctx.session.refresh(ticket)
244	    order = ctx.session.get(Order, ticket.order_id) if ticket.order_id else None
245	    if sent.status != 200 or order is None:
246	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form didn't accept a test order.",
247	                       f"POST {form.action}: status {sent.status} {sent.error}".strip())
248	    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "form_post", status_code=sent.status, nonce=ticket.nonce, source=web.source,
249	             server=sent.server, answer=f"order {order.ref}")
250	    sent_row = ctx.session.exec(select(Outbox).where(Outbox.key == f"order:{order.id}")).first()
251	    if order.email_status == "queued":  # S13: held back by our daily send budget (or not tried yet): our side
252	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works. Our test email is waiting its turn to be sent, "
253	                       "so we'll finish this check on the next round.",
254	                       f"order {order.ref}: test email queued ({sent_row.last_error if sent_row else 'not tried'})",
255	                       unfinished=True)
256	    if order.email_status != "sent" or sent_row is None or sent_row.status != "sent":
257	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works, but we couldn't send the order email.",
258	                       f"order {order.ref}: mail server refused or unreachable"
259	                       f"{f' ({sent_row.last_error})' if sent_row and sent_row.last_error else ''}")
260	    fake = ctx.integ.fake
261	    # the outbox's real send result: the Message-ID the mail server accepted, and which try it was
262	    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "smtp_accepted", message_id=sent_row.message_id, nonce=ticket.nonce,
263	             server="pretend mail server" if fake else ctx.settings.smtp_host, source="our mail server",
264	             answer=f"outbox {sent_row.id}, try {sent_row.attempts}")
265	    recipients = [r.lower() for r in order_recipients(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.business)]
266	    readable = fake or ctx.settings.imap_user.lower() in recipients
267	    if not readable:  # her own inbox: only she can prove it arrived
268	        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. Tap “Yes, I got it” "
269	                       "in that email to prove it reached your inbox.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}",
270	                       waiting=True)
271	    gaps = list(INBOX_GAPS) if ctx.inbox_wait else []
272	    if gaps:
273	        run_waiting(ctx, "test_email")  # the report says what we're waiting for, so it doesn't look stuck
274	    try:
275	        while True:
276	            if ctx.integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=ticket.nonce, since=started - timedelta(minutes=2)):
277	                evidence(ctx, "test_order", "imap_seen", nonce=ticket.nonce,
278	                         server="pretend inbox" if fake else ctx.settings.imap_host, source=ctx.settings.imap_user)
279	                return Outcome("test_order", True, "A test order reached your inbox.",
280	                               f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} found")
281	            if not gaps:
282	                break
283	            ctx.integ.sleep(gaps.pop(0))
284	    finally:
285	        if ctx.inbox_wait:
286	            run_waiting(ctx, None)
287	    if not ctx.inbox_wait:  # S13 B (monitoring): "accepted" is recorded; "seen" is looked for in a later short pass
288	        ctx.pending_inbox.append({"nonce": ticket.nonce, "since": (started - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),
289	                                  "ref": order.ref})
290	        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. We'll look for it in "
291	                       "the inbox again in a minute.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}: accepted, "
292	                       "inbox looked at once, looking again later", waiting=True)
293	    return Outcome("test_order", False, "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.",
294	                   f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} not found in {ctx.settings.imap_user} "
295	                   f"after {INBOX_WAIT_S} s")
296	
297	
298	# S17: how long a launch / "Check again" waits for the test email: a look at once, then every 5 s for the first 30 s,
299	# then every 10 s, up to 120 s in all; it stops at the first look that finds it. (Scheduled monitoring doesn't wait
300	# here: it looks again in later passes, monitor/scheduler.py INBOX_PASSES.)
301	INBOX_WAIT_S = 120
302	INBOX_GAPS = (5,) * 6 + (10,) * 9
303	assert sum(INBOX_GAPS) == INBOX_WAIT_S
304	
305	
306	def run_waiting(ctx: Ctx, what: str | None) -> None:
307	    """Mark the running CheckRun as waiting for something (shown on the report), or clear the mark."""
308	    if not ctx.run_id:
309	        return
310	    run = ctx.session.get(CheckRun, ctx.run_id)
311	    if run is None or run.status != "running":
312	        return
313	    info = json.loads(run.info_json or "{}")
314	    if what:
315	        info["waiting_for"] = what
316	    else:
317	        info.pop("waiting_for", None)
318	    run.info_json = json.dumps(info)
319	    ctx.session.add(run)
320	    ctx.session.commit()
321	
322	
323	def check_settings_match(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
324	    """Monitoring (daily): every setting the launch wrote still has the value it wrote."""
325	    current = {}
326	    for zone in {c["zone"] for c in ctx.changes}:
327	        for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(zone):
328	            current.setdefault((zone, r["type"], r["name"]), set()).add(str(r.get("data", "")))
329	    changed = []
330	    for c in ctx.changes:
331	        want = {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in c["after"]}
332	        have = current.get((c["zone"], c["type"], c["name"]), set())
333	        ok = bool(have) if (c["deferred"] or DKIM_PENDING in want) else want <= have
334	        if not ok:
335	            changed.append(f"{c['type']} {c['name']}")
336	    ok = not changed
337	    return Outcome("settings_match", ok, "Your settings are the same as at launch." if ok else
338	                   "Some of your settings changed since launch.", f"changed: {changed}" if changed else "all match")
339	
340	
341	CHECKS = {
342	    "site_points": check_site_points,
343	    "https": check_https,
344	    "email_mx": check_email_mx,
345	    "email_spf": check_email_spf,
346	    "email_dkim": check_email_dkim,
347	    "email_dmarc": check_email_dmarc,
348	    "test_order": check_test_order,
349	    "settings_match": check_settings_match,  # monitoring only
350	}
351	LAUNCH_CHECKS = ["site_points", "https", "email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc", "test_order"]
352	TITLES = {
353	    "site_points": "Your address leads to your website",
354	    "https": "Your website opens securely",
355	    "email_mx": "Emails reach your mailbox",
356	    "email_spf": "Your mailbox may send email for you",
357	    "email_dkim": "Your emails are signed",
358	    "email_dmarc": "Protection against fake emails in your name",
359	    "test_order": "A test order reached your inbox",
360	    "settings_match": "Your settings are unchanged since launch",
361	}
362	
363	
364	def checks_for(ctx: Ctx) -> list[str]:
365	    return list(LAUNCH_CHECKS)  # the same proof for every launch; only the allowed fixes differ by mode
366	
367	
368	def outcome_of(ctx: Ctx, name: str) -> Outcome:
369	    try:
370	        return CHECKS[name](ctx)
371	    except CouldntCheck as e:
372	        return Outcome(name, False, OUR_SIDE, str(e), unfinished=True)
373	    except Exception as e:  # a check that crashes is a failed check, never a crash of the launch
374	        return Outcome(name, False, "We couldn't complete this check.", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300])
375	
376	
377	def run_check(ctx: Ctx, name: str, attempt: int = 0) -> Outcome:
378	    out = outcome_of(ctx, name)
379	    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, attempt)
380	    return out
381	
382	
383	WATCHDOG_TEXT = ("This check took too long, so we stopped waiting for it. We don't know yet; we'll try again on the "
384	                 "next round.")
385	
386	
387	def run_check_watched(engine, ctx: Ctx, name: str, seconds: float) -> Outcome:
388	    """S13 B: a per-check watchdog. The check runs in its own thread with its OWN database session and copies of
389	    the shop's rows, so if it overruns we can stop waiting safely: it's marked "couldn't finish" (never passed),
390	    and the late thread can't write proof (ctx.abandoned). Python can't stop a thread: the late call keeps going
391	    until its own timeout, but nobody waits for it."""
392	    import threading
393	
394	    from app.models import Business, Plan
395	
396	    own = Session(engine)
397	    wctx = Ctx(own, ctx.settings, ctx.integ, own.get(Plan, ctx.plan.id), own.get(Business, ctx.business.id),
398	               run_id=ctx.run_id, inbox_wait=ctx.inbox_wait)
399	    box: dict = {}
400	
401	    def work():
402	        try:
403	            box["out"] = outcome_of(wctx, name)
404	        finally:
405	            own.close()
406	
407	    t = threading.Thread(target=work, name=f"check-{name}-{ctx.business.id}", daemon=True)
408	    t.start()
409	    t.join(seconds)
410	    if t.is_alive() or "out" not in box:
411	        wctx.abandoned = True
412	        out = Outcome(name, False, WATCHDOG_TEXT, f"no answer within {seconds:.0f}s: stopped waiting", unfinished=True)
413	    else:
414	        out = box["out"]
415	        ctx.pending_inbox.extend(wctx.pending_inbox)
416	    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, 0)
417	    return out
418	
419	
420	def save(session: Session, ctx: Ctx, out: Outcome, attempt: int) -> None:
421	    session.add(CheckResult(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, run_id=ctx.run_id, check=out.check, passed=out.passed,
422	                            detail=json.dumps({"plain": out.plain, "detail": out.detail, "waiting": out.waiting,
423	                                               **({"unfinished": True} if out.unfinished else {})}),
424	                            attempt=attempt))
425	    if out.check.startswith("email_") and out.passed:
426	        evidence(ctx, out.check, "dns_answer", answer=out.detail[:200], server=dns_server(ctx),
427	                 source="authoritative nameserver")
428	    session.commit()
429	    audit.record(session, actor="checker", action=f"check_{out.check}", target=ctx.plan.site_host,
430	                 result="pass" if out.passed else "fail", business_id=ctx.business.id,
431	                 detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {out.detail}"[:500])
432	
433	
434	def run_all(ctx: Ctx) -> list[Outcome]:
435	    return [run_check(ctx, name) for name in checks_for(ctx)]

"""Checker (code only): proves a finished launch works (SPEC §6).

Checks: site points to the server (asked of the AUTHORITATIVE nameservers via
`integ.dns`), site opens over HTTPS with a valid certificate, email settings
(MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC of the domain the order mailbox is on, compared with the
mail provider table; read-only), and a real test order arrives. Each result is
stored as a CheckResult row and an AuditEvent. Launch steps are not a check:
the report shows them separately.
"""

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from urllib.parse import urljoin

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit, proof
from app.agents.executor import Ctx
from app.agents.planner import DKIM_PENDING
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.checks.dns_resolver import lookup
from app.mail.providers import provider_for
from app.models import CheckResult, CheckRun, Order, Outbox, utcnow
from app.sites.orders import order_recipients


@dataclass
class Outcome:
    check: str
    passed: bool
    plain: str  # one line for the seller
    detail: str = ""  # technical
    waiting: bool = False  # passed as far as we can see, but delivery still needs the owner's "Yes, I got it"
    unfinished: bool = False  # we couldn't complete it (our lookup failed, or time ran out): not passed, not her fault
    keeps_breaking: bool = False  # fixed several times today and broken again: automatic fixing has stopped


class CouldntCheck(Exception):
    """Something on OUR side failed, so the check has no answer. Never a failure of the shop."""


OUR_SIDE = ("We couldn't look this up just now. The problem is on our side, not yours, and nothing about your shop has "
            "changed. We'll check again on the next round.")
OUT_OF_TIME = "This check couldn't finish in time, so we don't know yet. We'll try again on the next round."


def dns_values(ctx: Ctx, name: str, rtype: str) -> list[str]:
    """One DNS answer for a check. A lookup that failed on our side raises, so it can't be read as "missing"."""
    got = lookup(ctx.integ.dns, name, rtype)
    if got.status == "error":
        raise CouldntCheck(f"{rtype} {name}: our lookup failed")
    return list(got.values)


def practice_world(ctx: Ctx) -> bool:
    return bool(ctx.integ.fake or ctx.business.practice)


def evidence(ctx: Ctx, check: str, step: str, **fields) -> None:
    if ctx.abandoned:  # S13 B: the watchdog gave up on this check; its late answers aren't proof of this run
        return
    proof.add(ctx.session, business=ctx.business, run_id=ctx.run_id, check=check, step=step,
              practice=practice_world(ctx), **fields)


def dns_server(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    return getattr(ctx.integ.dns, "last_server", "") or ("pretend nameserver" if ctx.integ.fake else "")


def shop_web(ctx: Ctx) -> proof.ShopWeb:
    """How the checker reaches the shop like a customer: in-process for practice, else over the internet
    to the shop's own host only (SSRF-guarded)."""
    factory = getattr(ctx.integ, "shop_web", None)
    if factory is not None:
        return factory(ctx)
    if practice_world(ctx):
        return proof.PracticeShopWeb(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.integ.mailer, ctx.business, ctx.plan.site_host)
    return proof.real_shop_web(ctx.plan.site_host)


def _txt(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [v.strip('"') for v in values]


def check_site_points(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    host, want = ctx.plan.site_host, ctx.settings.server_ip
    got = dns_values(ctx, host, "A")
    ok = want in got
    evidence(ctx, "site_points", "dns_answer", answer=f"A {host} = {', '.join(got) or 'nothing'}",
             server=dns_server(ctx), source="authoritative nameserver")
    return Outcome("site_points", ok, "Your address leads to your website." if ok else
                   "Your address doesn't lead to your website yet.", f"A {host} = {got or 'nothing'}; want {want}")


def public_resolvers_text(want: str, seen: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> str:
    """`seen` = [(label, Answer)]. "Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers" (+ who differs, plainly) | the answers."""
    agree = [label for label, a in seen if a.status == "ok" and want in a.values]
    head = f"Reachable from {len(agree)} of {len(seen)} public resolvers"
    odd = []
    for label, a in seen:
        if label in agree:
            continue
        name = label.split(" ")[-2]  # "Quad9 9.9.9.9" or "pretend Quad9 9.9.9.9" -> "Quad9"
        odd.append(f"{name} didn't answer us" if a.status == "error" else
                   f"{name} has no address for it yet" if not a.values else f"{name} still shows an old address")
    if odd:
        head += f" ({'; '.join(odd)}: this usually clears by itself within hours; no alert for this)"
    answers = "; ".join(f"{label}: {', '.join(a.values) or ('no answer' if a.status == 'error' else 'nothing')}"
                        for label, a in seen)
    return f"{head} | {answers}"


def public_resolvers(session: Session, business, run_id: int, host: str, want: str, integ) -> dict | None:
    """S13b, the daily run only: ask 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1 and 9.9.9.9 for the shop's address and save what they say
    through `proof.add`. Information only: the shop's own nameservers (check_site_points) stay the proof and the only
    thing that can fail or alert; a public resolver that disagrees is shown plainly, never alerted on."""
    factory = getattr(integ, "public_dns", None)
    if factory is None:
        return None
    seen = [(label, lookup(resolver, host, "A")) for label, resolver in factory()]
    if not seen:
        return None
    text = public_resolvers_text(want, seen)
    proof.add(session, business=business, run_id=run_id, check="site_points", step="public_resolvers",
              practice=bool(integ.fake or business.practice), answer=text[:500],
              server=", ".join(label for label, _a in seen),
              source="pretend public resolvers" if integ.fake else "public resolvers")
    session.commit()
    agree = sum(1 for _label, a in seen if a.status == "ok" and want in a.values)
    return {"agree": agree, "asked": len(seen), "text": text}


HTTPS_BACKOFF = (5, 10, 20, 40, 45)  # seconds: up to 2 minutes while a new certificate is being issued


def check_https(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    url = f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/"
    for i in range(len(HTTPS_BACKOFF) + 1):
        r = ctx.integ.http.fetch(url)
        if r.ok and r.cert_valid:
            break
        if i < len(HTTPS_BACKOFF):
            ctx.integ.sleep(HTTPS_BACKOFF[i])
    ok = r.ok and r.cert_valid
    detail = f"status={r.status} cert_valid={r.cert_valid} {r.error}".strip()
    if not ok:
        plain = ("Your website's security certificate isn't working yet." if not r.cert_valid else
                 "Your website didn't open.")
        return Outcome("https", False, plain, detail)
    page = shop_web(ctx).get(url)
    if proof.marker(ctx.business) not in page.html:  # a parked page with a valid certificate is not her shop
        return Outcome("https", False, "Your address opens a page, but it isn't your shop.",
                       f"{detail}; shop marker missing (page status {page.status})")
    cert_end = ctx.integ.http.cert_expires(ctx.plan.site_host)
    evidence(ctx, "https", "http_response", status_code=r.status, cert_not_after=cert_end, server=page.server,
             source=url, answer="shop page with its lw-shop marker")
    return Outcome("https", True, "Your website opens securely (the padlock shows).", detail)


def mail_zone(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    """The domain whose mail settings matter for this shop's orders: the seller's own domain on
    an own-name launch, else the domain the order mailbox is on (the app's)."""
    return ctx.plan.zone if ctx.plan.mode == "full" else ctx.plan.mailbox.rsplit("@", 1)[-1].lower()


def check_email_mx(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    zone, provider = mail_zone(ctx), provider_for(ctx.settings)
    got = dns_values(ctx, zone, "MX")
    hosts = {v.split()[-1].rstrip(".").lower() for v in got}
    ok = all(h in hosts for _, h in provider.mx)
    return Outcome("email_mx", ok, "Emails to your address reach your mailbox." if ok else
                   "Emails sent to your address can't reach your mailbox.",
                   f"MX {zone} = {got or 'nothing'}; expected {provider.label}")


def check_email_spf(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    zone, provider = mail_zone(ctx), provider_for(ctx.settings)
    got = _txt(dns_values(ctx, zone, "TXT"))
    ok = any(v.startswith("v=spf1") and provider.spf_include in v for v in got)
    return Outcome("email_spf", ok, "Your mailbox is allowed to send email for you." if ok else
                   "Your emails may land in spam: the sending permission is missing.",
                   f"TXT {zone} = {got or 'nothing'}; expected {provider.spf_include}")


def dkim_names(ctx: Ctx, zone: str) -> list[str]:
    """Signing record names: the ones this launch planned, else whatever the live zone has."""
    names = [c["name"] for c in ctx.changes if c["name"].endswith("._domainkey")]
    if not names:
        try:
            names = sorted({r["name"] for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(zone) if r["name"].endswith("._domainkey")})
        except Exception:  # can't list the zone (not ours): fall back to the provider's usual names
            names = []
    return names or [f"{sel}._domainkey" for sel in provider_for(ctx.settings).dkim_selectors]


def check_email_dkim(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    zone = mail_zone(ctx)
    names, seen = dkim_names(ctx, zone), {}
    for name in names:
        txt = _txt(dns_values(ctx, f"{name}.{zone}", "TXT"))
        seen[name] = (any(v.startswith("v=DKIM1") and "p=" in v for v in txt)
                      or bool(dns_values(ctx, f"{name}.{zone}", "CNAME")))
    ok = bool(seen) and all(seen.values())
    return Outcome("email_dkim", ok, "Your emails are signed so customers can trust them." if ok else
                   "Your emails aren't signed, so they may land in spam.",
                   f"signing records on {zone}: {seen or 'none found'}")


def check_email_dmarc(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    zone = mail_zone(ctx)
    got = _txt(dns_values(ctx, f"_dmarc.{zone}", "TXT"))
    ok = any(v.startswith("v=DMARC1") for v in got)
    return Outcome("email_dmarc", ok, "Fake emails in your name will be treated as spam." if ok else
                   "Order emails could land in spam: a protection setting is missing.",
                   f"TXT _dmarc.{zone} = {got or 'nothing'}")


TEST_CUSTOMER = {"customer_name": "LaunchWitness test", "customer_phone": "0000000000",
                 "note": "Automatic test order from your launch check. No action needed."}


def check_test_order(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    """Order from the shop like a customer: open the public page, find the order form, post it with a
    one-time test code, then record each hop separately. Delivery is proven only by finding the email in
    an inbox we can read, or by the owner tapping "Yes, I got it"; a mail server's "accepted" is not delivery."""
    url = f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/"
    web = shop_web(ctx)
    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(ctx.business.profile_json)
    page = web.get(url)
    form = proof.find_order_form(page.html) if page.status == 200 else None
    if form is None:
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't open your order form for a test order.",
                       f"GET {url}: status {page.status} {page.error}".strip())
    index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(profile.products) if not x.addon), 0)
    field = f"qty_{index}"
    if field not in form.qty_fields:
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't find an item to order on your page.", f"{field} not in form")
    ticket = proof.new_ticket(ctx.session, ctx.business, ctx.run_id)
    started = utcnow()
    fields = {**form.hidden, **TEST_CUSTOMER, field: "1", "lw_test": ticket.nonce}
    sent = web.post(urljoin(url, form.action), fields)
    ctx.session.refresh(ticket)
    order = ctx.session.get(Order, ticket.order_id) if ticket.order_id else None
    if sent.status != 200 or order is None:
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form didn't accept a test order.",
                       f"POST {form.action}: status {sent.status} {sent.error}".strip())
    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "form_post", status_code=sent.status, nonce=ticket.nonce, source=web.source,
             server=sent.server, answer=f"order {order.ref}")
    sent_row = ctx.session.exec(select(Outbox).where(Outbox.key == f"order:{order.id}")).first()
    if order.email_status == "queued":  # S13: held back by our daily send budget (or not tried yet): our side
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works. Our test email is waiting its turn to be sent, "
                       "so we'll finish this check on the next round.",
                       f"order {order.ref}: test email queued ({sent_row.last_error if sent_row else 'not tried'})",
                       unfinished=True)
    if order.email_status != "sent" or sent_row is None or sent_row.status != "sent":
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works, but we couldn't send the order email.",
                       f"order {order.ref}: mail server refused or unreachable"
                       f"{f' ({sent_row.last_error})' if sent_row and sent_row.last_error else ''}")
    fake = ctx.integ.fake
    # the outbox's real send result: the Message-ID the mail server accepted, and which try it was
    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "smtp_accepted", message_id=sent_row.message_id, nonce=ticket.nonce,
             server="pretend mail server" if fake else ctx.settings.smtp_host, source="our mail server",
             answer=f"outbox {sent_row.id}, try {sent_row.attempts}")
    recipients = [r.lower() for r in order_recipients(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.business)]
    readable = fake or ctx.settings.imap_user.lower() in recipients
    if not readable:  # her own inbox: only she can prove it arrived
        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. Tap “Yes, I got it” "
                       "in that email to prove it reached your inbox.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}",
                       waiting=True)
    gaps = list(INBOX_GAPS) if ctx.inbox_wait else []
    if gaps:
        run_waiting(ctx, "test_email")  # the report says what we're waiting for, so it doesn't look stuck
    try:
        while True:
            if ctx.integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=ticket.nonce, since=started - timedelta(minutes=2)):
                evidence(ctx, "test_order", "imap_seen", nonce=ticket.nonce,
                         server="pretend inbox" if fake else ctx.settings.imap_host, source=ctx.settings.imap_user)
                return Outcome("test_order", True, "A test order reached your inbox.",
                               f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} found")
            if not gaps:
                break
            ctx.integ.sleep(gaps.pop(0))
    finally:
        if ctx.inbox_wait:
            run_waiting(ctx, None)
    if not ctx.inbox_wait:  # S13 B (monitoring): "accepted" is recorded; "seen" is looked for in a later short pass
        ctx.pending_inbox.append({"nonce": ticket.nonce, "since": (started - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),
                                  "ref": order.ref})
        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. We'll look for it in "
                       "the inbox again in a minute.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}: accepted, "
                       "inbox looked at once, looking again later", waiting=True)
    return Outcome("test_order", False, "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.",
                   f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} not found in {ctx.settings.imap_user} "
                   f"after {INBOX_WAIT_S} s")


# S17: how long a launch / "Check again" waits for the test email: a look at once, then every 5 s for the first 30 s,
# then every 10 s, up to 120 s in all; it stops at the first look that finds it. (Scheduled monitoring doesn't wait
# here: it looks again in later passes, monitor/scheduler.py INBOX_PASSES.)
INBOX_WAIT_S = 120
INBOX_GAPS = (5,) * 6 + (10,) * 9
assert sum(INBOX_GAPS) == INBOX_WAIT_S


def run_waiting(ctx: Ctx, what: str | None) -> None:
    """Mark the running CheckRun as waiting for something (shown on the report), or clear the mark."""
    if not ctx.run_id:
        return
    run = ctx.session.get(CheckRun, ctx.run_id)
    if run is None or run.status != "running":
        return
    info = json.loads(run.info_json or "{}")
    if what:
        info["waiting_for"] = what
    else:
        info.pop("waiting_for", None)
    run.info_json = json.dumps(info)
    ctx.session.add(run)
    ctx.session.commit()


def check_settings_match(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    """Monitoring (daily): every setting the launch wrote still has the value it wrote."""
    current = {}
    for zone in {c["zone"] for c in ctx.changes}:
        for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(zone):
            current.setdefault((zone, r["type"], r["name"]), set()).add(str(r.get("data", "")))
    changed = []
    for c in ctx.changes:
        want = {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in c["after"]}
        have = current.get((c["zone"], c["type"], c["name"]), set())
        ok = bool(have) if (c["deferred"] or DKIM_PENDING in want) else want <= have
        if not ok:
            changed.append(f"{c['type']} {c['name']}")
    ok = not changed
    return Outcome("settings_match", ok, "Your settings are the same as at launch." if ok else
                   "Some of your settings changed since launch.", f"changed: {changed}" if changed else "all match")


CHECKS = {
    "site_points": check_site_points,
    "https": check_https,
    "email_mx": check_email_mx,
    "email_spf": check_email_spf,
    "email_dkim": check_email_dkim,
    "email_dmarc": check_email_dmarc,
    "test_order": check_test_order,
    "settings_match": check_settings_match,  # monitoring only
}
LAUNCH_CHECKS = ["site_points", "https", "email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc", "test_order"]
TITLES = {
    "site_points": "Your address leads to your website",
    "https": "Your website opens securely",
    "email_mx": "Emails reach your mailbox",
    "email_spf": "Your mailbox may send email for you",
    "email_dkim": "Your emails are signed",
    "email_dmarc": "Protection against fake emails in your name",
    "test_order": "A test order reached your inbox",
    "settings_match": "Your settings are unchanged since launch",
}


def checks_for(ctx: Ctx) -> list[str]:
    return list(LAUNCH_CHECKS)  # the same proof for every launch; only the allowed fixes differ by mode


def outcome_of(ctx: Ctx, name: str) -> Outcome:
    try:
        return CHECKS[name](ctx)
    except CouldntCheck as e:
        return Outcome(name, False, OUR_SIDE, str(e), unfinished=True)
    except Exception as e:  # a check that crashes is a failed check, never a crash of the launch
        return Outcome(name, False, "We couldn't complete this check.", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300])


def run_check(ctx: Ctx, name: str, attempt: int = 0) -> Outcome:
    out = outcome_of(ctx, name)
    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, attempt)
    return out


WATCHDOG_TEXT = ("This check took too long, so we stopped waiting for it. We don't know yet; we'll try again on the "
                 "next round.")


def run_check_watched(engine, ctx: Ctx, name: str, seconds: float) -> Outcome:
    """S13 B: a per-check watchdog. The check runs in its own thread with its OWN database session and copies of
    the shop's rows, so if it overruns we can stop waiting safely: it's marked "couldn't finish" (never passed),
    and the late thread can't write proof (ctx.abandoned). Python can't stop a thread: the late call keeps going
    until its own timeout, but nobody waits for it."""
    import threading

    from app.models import Business, Plan

    own = Session(engine)
    wctx = Ctx(own, ctx.settings, ctx.integ, own.get(Plan, ctx.plan.id), own.get(Business, ctx.business.id),
               run_id=ctx.run_id, inbox_wait=ctx.inbox_wait)
    box: dict = {}

    def work():
        try:
            box["out"] = outcome_of(wctx, name)
        finally:
            own.close()

    t = threading.Thread(target=work, name=f"check-{name}-{ctx.business.id}", daemon=True)
    t.start()
    t.join(seconds)
    if t.is_alive() or "out" not in box:
        wctx.abandoned = True
        out = Outcome(name, False, WATCHDOG_TEXT, f"no answer within {seconds:.0f}s: stopped waiting", unfinished=True)
    else:
        out = box["out"]
        ctx.pending_inbox.extend(wctx.pending_inbox)
    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, 0)
    return out


def save(session: Session, ctx: Ctx, out: Outcome, attempt: int) -> None:
    session.add(CheckResult(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, run_id=ctx.run_id, check=out.check, passed=out.passed,
                            detail=json.dumps({"plain": out.plain, "detail": out.detail, "waiting": out.waiting,
                                               **({"unfinished": True} if out.unfinished else {})}),
                            attempt=attempt))
    if out.check.startswith("email_") and out.passed:
        evidence(ctx, out.check, "dns_answer", answer=out.detail[:200], server=dns_server(ctx),
                 source="authoritative nameserver")
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="checker", action=f"check_{out.check}", target=ctx.plan.site_host,
                 result="pass" if out.passed else "fail", business_id=ctx.business.id,
                 detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {out.detail}"[:500])


def run_all(ctx: Ctx) -> list[Outcome]:
    return [run_check(ctx, name) for name in checks_for(ctx)]

"""Orders placed through a seller site's form: validate, store, email."""

import json
import re
import secrets
from datetime import date, timedelta

from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.config import Settings
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer
from app.models import Business, Order, utcnow
from app.safety.access import owner_emails, run_by_team
from app.sites import fulfilment as ful

MAX_QTY = 50

# The owner's order status. New → Confirmed → Paid → Done, or Cancelled before it's done. Paid can be
# skipped (cash on pickup). Nothing goes back, and Done / Cancelled are final.
STATUS_STEPS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "new": ("confirmed", "cancelled"),
    "confirmed": ("paid", "done", "cancelled"),
    "paid": ("done", "cancelled"),
    "done": (),
    "cancelled": (),
}
STATUS_LABELS = {"new": "New", "confirmed": "Confirmed", "paid": "Paid", "done": "Done", "cancelled": "Cancelled"}


def can_move(current: str, to: str) -> bool:
    return to in STATUS_STEPS.get(current, ())


def customer_whatsapp_link(shop_name: str, order: Order) -> str | None:
    """A wa.me link to the CUSTOMER's phone with a ready-typed message from the owner. Nothing is sent by us:
    the owner's own WhatsApp opens with the text, and she presses send."""
    from urllib.parse import quote

    from app.sites.render import format_inr, whatsapp_digits

    number = whatsapp_digits(order.customer_phone)
    if not 11 <= len(number) <= 15:  # 10-digit Indian mobiles were given +91 above
        return None
    first = order.customer_name.split()[0] if order.customer_name.split() else ""
    text = (f"Hi {first}, this is {shop_name}. Got your order {order.ref} for {format_inr(order.total_inr)}. "
            "I'll confirm the details here.")
    return f"https://wa.me/{number}?text={quote(text, safe='')}"


def tel_link(phone: str) -> str:
    from app.sites.render import whatsapp_digits

    digits = whatsapp_digits(phone)
    return f"tel:+{digits}" if digits else ""


class OrderInvalid(ValueError):
    """Message is shown to the customer as-is."""


TEST_ADDRESS = "Automatic test order. No real address."
TEST_PIN = "110001"  # a valid PIN code; for local delivery the test address names a place she serves (see test_defaults)


def test_defaults(profile: Profile) -> dict[str, str]:
    """What the checker's test order fills in for the fields it doesn't know about: pickup when she offers pickup,
    otherwise a delivery INSIDE her area (her first listed PIN, or a test address naming her first locality). The same
    checks a customer's order faces then run on it, so a test order proves the real path in every selling mode."""
    o = ful.offers(profile)
    if o["pickup"]:
        return {"fulfilment": "pickup"}
    if o["local"]:
        a = ful.parse_areas(profile.delivery_areas)
        where = a.localities[0] if a.localities else ""
        return {"fulfilment": "delivery", "delivery_address": f"{TEST_ADDRESS} {where}".strip(),
                "delivery_pin": a.pins[0] if a.pins else TEST_PIN}
    if o["india"]:
        return {"fulfilment": "delivery", "delivery_address": TEST_ADDRESS, "delivery_pin": TEST_PIN}
    return {}


def clean_address(text: str) -> str:
    """A multi-line address: each line tidied, blank lines dropped, 300 characters at most."""
    lines = [" ".join(line.split()) for line in text.splitlines()]
    return "\n".join(x for x in lines if x)[:300]


def delivery_refusal(profile: Profile) -> str:
    where = ful.area_phrase(profile)
    pickup = " You could choose pickup instead." if ful.offers(profile)["pickup"] else ""
    if where:
        return f"{profile.name} delivers only in {where}.{pickup}"
    return f"{profile.name} can't deliver to that address yet.{pickup}"


def orders_on(session: Session, business_id: int, day: str) -> int:
    """Her real orders already wanted on this date (cancelled ones free the day up; test orders never count)."""
    return session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        Order.business_id == business_id, Order.is_test == False, Order.wanted_date == day,  # noqa: E712
        Order.status != "cancelled")).one()


def full_days(session: Session | None, business: Business | None, profile: Profile, today: date | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Dates that reached her daily limit (for the date picker): only dates, never who ordered."""
    if session is None or business is None or not profile.max_orders_per_day:
        return []
    today = today or ful.today_ist()
    rows = session.exec(select(Order.wanted_date, func.count()).where(
        Order.business_id == business.id, Order.is_test == False, Order.status != "cancelled",  # noqa: E712
        Order.wanted_date >= today.isoformat()).group_by(Order.wanted_date)).all()
    return ful.full_dates({d: n for d, n in rows if d}, profile)


def parse_order_form(form: dict[str, str], profile: Profile, *, test: bool = False, session: Session | None = None,
                     business: Business | None = None, today: date | None = None) -> dict:
    """Everything the customer sent, checked against the shop's own rules. Prices, fees and totals come ONLY from the
    profile: a price or fee field in the form is never read. `test` fills the fulfilment fields (see test_defaults) and
    leaves the date out; a customer's order must give them. Raises OrderInvalid with a message fit to show as-is."""
    if form.get("website"):  # honeypot field, hidden from people
        raise OrderInvalid("Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.")
    today = today or ful.today_ist()
    if test:
        form = {**test_defaults(profile), **{k: v for k, v in form.items() if v}}
    name = " ".join(form.get("customer_name", "").split())[:80]
    phone = form.get("customer_phone", "").strip()
    note = form.get("note", "").strip()[:1000]
    if profile.allow_item_message:
        message = " ".join(form.get("item_message", "").split())[:200]
        if message:
            note = f"Message on the item: {message}" + (f"\n{note}" if note else "")
    if not name:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add your name so we know who the order is for.")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\+?[\d\s-]{10,20}", phone) or len(re.sub(r"\D", "", phone)) < 10:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add a phone number we can call or WhatsApp (at least 10 digits).")
    items = []
    for i, product in enumerate(profile.products):
        raw = form.get(f"qty_{i}", "0").strip() or "0"
        if not raw.isdigit() or int(raw) > MAX_QTY:
            raise OrderInvalid(f"Please enter a quantity between 0 and {MAX_QTY}.")
        if int(raw) > 0:
            items.append({"name": product.name, "qty": int(raw), "price_inr": product.price_inr,
                          "addon": product.addon})
    if not items and not note:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please choose at least one item, or tell us what you'd like in the note.")
    if items and all(it["addon"] for it in items):
        raise OrderInvalid("Extras go with another item. Please choose an item too.")
    for it in items:
        del it["addon"]

    # --- how it gets to the customer
    o = ful.offers(profile)
    choices = [c for c, on in (("pickup", o["pickup"]), ("delivery", o["local"] or o["india"])) if on]
    fulfilment, address, pin = "", "", ""
    if choices:
        asked = form.get("fulfilment", "").strip()
        if not asked and len(choices) == 1:
            asked = choices[0]
        if asked not in choices:
            raise OrderInvalid("Please choose " + (" or ".join(c if c == "pickup" else "delivery" for c in choices)) + ".")
        fulfilment = asked
    if fulfilment == "delivery":
        address = clean_address(form.get("delivery_address", ""))
        pin = re.sub(r"\s", "", form.get("delivery_pin", ""))
        if len(address) < 6:
            raise OrderInvalid("Please add the address we should deliver to.")
        if not ful.PIN.fullmatch(pin):
            raise OrderInvalid("Please add your 6-digit PIN code.")
        if o["local"] and not ful.serves(profile, address, pin):
            raise OrderInvalid(delivery_refusal(profile))

    # --- when
    wanted = ""
    raw_date = form.get("wanted_date", "").strip()
    if raw_date:
        day = ful.parse_date(raw_date)
        if day is None:
            raise OrderInvalid("Please pick the date you want your order by.")
        taken = orders_on(session, business.id, day.isoformat()) if session is not None and business is not None else 0
        if problem := ful.date_problem(profile, day, today, taken):
            raise OrderInvalid(problem)
        wanted = day.isoformat()
    elif ful.date_required(profile) and not test:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please pick the date you want your order by.")
    slot = " ".join(form.get("time_slot", "").split())
    if profile.time_slots and slot and slot not in profile.time_slots:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please pick one of the time slots on the list.")
    if not profile.time_slots:
        slot = ""

    # --- the money, worked out here from the menu
    items_sum = ful.items_total(items)
    fee = ful.fee_for(profile, fulfilment, items_sum)
    total = items_sum + fee
    pay_now, pay_later = ful.pay_split(profile, total)
    return {"customer_name": name, "customer_phone": phone, "note": note, "items": items, "total_inr": total,
            "items_inr": items_sum, "fee_inr": fee, "fulfilment": fulfilment, "delivery_address": address,
            "delivery_pin": pin, "wanted_date": wanted, "time_slot": slot, "payment_terms": profile.payment_terms,
            "pay_now_inr": pay_now, "pay_later_inr": pay_later}


def order_email(business: Business, profile: Profile, order: Order, items: list[dict],
                confirm_url: str = "", orders_url: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
    from app.sites.render import format_inr

    test = "[TEST] " if order.is_test else ""
    code = f" [{order.nonce}]" if order.nonce else ""
    subject = f"{test}New order for {profile.name} from {order.customer_name} ({order.ref}){code}"
    lines = [f"New order {order.ref} for {profile.name}", "", f"Customer: {order.customer_name}",
             f"Phone: {order.customer_phone}"]
    if tel := tel_link(order.customer_phone):
        lines.append(f"Call: {tel}")
    if wa := customer_whatsapp_link(profile.name, order):
        lines.append(f"WhatsApp the customer: {wa}")
    lines.append("")
    if order.nonce:
        lines[1:1] = ["", "This is an automatic test order from LaunchWitness. No customer is waiting.",
                      f"Test code: {order.nonce}"]
    lines += [f"- {it['qty']} x {it['name']} @ {format_inr(it['price_inr'])} = {format_inr(it['qty'] * it['price_inr'])}"
              for it in items] or ["(no items chosen; see note)"]
    if order.fee_inr:
        what = "Shipping" if ful.offers(profile)["india"] else "Delivery"
        lines.append(f"- {what}: {format_inr(order.fee_inr)}")
    lines += ["", f"Total: {format_inr(order.total_inr)}"]
    if order.payment_terms:  # S15: what the customer was told to pay, and what is left
        lines.append(f"Paid now (asked of the customer): {format_inr(order.pay_now_inr)}" if order.pay_now_inr
                     else "Nothing asked to be paid now.")
        if order.pay_later_inr:
            lines.append(f"Due on {'delivery' if order.fulfilment == 'delivery' else 'pickup'}: {format_inr(order.pay_later_inr)}")
    if order.fulfilment == "pickup":
        lines += ["", "How: PICKUP. Send the exact address on WhatsApp once you confirm the order."]
    elif order.fulfilment == "delivery":
        lines += ["", "How: " + ("SHIPPING across India" if ful.offers(profile)["india"] else "LOCAL DELIVERY"),
                  "Deliver to:", *order.delivery_address.splitlines(), f"PIN code: {order.delivery_pin}"]
        if ful.offers(profile)["india"] and profile.dispatch_days:
            lines.append(f"Dispatch within {profile.dispatch_days} day{'s' if profile.dispatch_days != 1 else ''}.")
    if order.wanted_date:
        d = ful.parse_date(order.wanted_date)
        lines.append(f"Wanted by: {ful.nice_date(d) if d else order.wanted_date}" + (f", {order.time_slot}" if order.time_slot else ""))
    if cancel := ful.cancellation_line(profile):
        lines += ["", f"Your cancellation rule shown to the customer: {cancel}"]
    if order.note:
        lines += ["", "Note from customer:", order.note]
    if confirm_url:
        lines += ["", "Did this email reach you? Tap here to say so (it proves your orders reach you):", confirm_url]
    if orders_url:
        lines += ["", f"See and update all your orders: {orders_url}"]
    lines += ["", f"Placed: {order.created_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC", "Sent by LaunchWitness"]
    return subject, "\n".join(lines)


def order_recipients(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business) -> list[str]:
    """Who gets this shop's order emails. ONE place decides it, for customers' orders and for the
    checker's test order alike: the owner's verified sign-in address. That address was proven at
    sign-in and is proven again by the test order. The app's own mailbox is added only for shops
    we run ourselves, and stands in while a guest practice shop has no owner yet."""
    out = owner_emails(session, business.id)
    if not out or run_by_team(session, business.id):
        if settings.smtp_user.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in out}:
            out.append(settings.smtp_user)
    return out


REF_ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"  # no 0/O/1/I


def new_ref() -> str:
    """Public order reference: random, so it reveals no count and can't be guessed."""
    return "LW-" + "".join(secrets.choice(REF_ALPHABET) for _ in range(8))


TOO_MANY = ("This shop has had a lot of orders from here in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes, "
            "or message the shop directly.")


class TooManyOrders(Exception):
    pass


def check_order_limits(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business, visitor: str) -> None:
    """Per visitor (hashed IP) per shop per hour, and per shop per day. Test orders don't count."""
    real = (Order.business_id == business.id, Order.is_test == False)  # noqa: E712
    now = utcnow()
    mine = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.visitor == visitor, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(hours=1))).one()
    shop = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(days=1))).one()
    if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour or shop >= settings.orders_per_shop_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}",
                     result="blocked", business_id=business.id,
                     detail="visitor hourly limit" if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour else "shop daily limit")
        raise TooManyOrders


TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$")


def existing_order(session: Session, business: Business, token: str) -> Order | None:
    """The order already made with this form token (a double tap or a re-sent form), if any."""
    if not TOKEN.match(token):
        return None
    return session.exec(select(Order).where(Order.business_id == business.id, Order.client_token == token)).first()


def order_view(order: Order) -> dict:
    """What the thank-you page may show. Deliberately NOT the street address: that stays with the owner."""
    return {"customer_name": order.customer_name, "customer_phone": order.customer_phone, "note": order.note,
            "items": json.loads(order.items_json), "total_inr": order.total_inr, "ref": order.ref,
            "fulfilment": order.fulfilment, "delivery_pin": order.delivery_pin, "wanted_date": order.wanted_date,
            "time_slot": order.time_slot, "fee_inr": order.fee_inr, "payment_terms": order.payment_terms,
            "pay_now_inr": order.pay_now_inr, "pay_later_inr": order.pay_later_inr}


def place_order(session: Session, mailer: Mailer, settings: Settings, *, business: Business, profile: Profile,
                data: dict, is_test: bool = False, nonce: str = "", visitor: str = "", token: str = "",
                confirm_url: str = "", channel: str = "smtp") -> Order:
    """Store the order, then email it to `order_recipients` through the outbox. The launch check's test order and
    a customer's order both come through here, so a passing test order proves the real path.

    S13: the order is saved first and its email queued; the outbox tries it at once and keeps retrying if the
    mail server is slow or down, so a customer's order is never lost. `email_status` follows the outbox row."""
    from app import outbox

    order = Order(business_id=business.id, customer_name=data["customer_name"], customer_phone=data["customer_phone"],
                  items_json=json.dumps(data["items"], ensure_ascii=False), total_inr=data["total_inr"],
                  note=data["note"], is_test=is_test, nonce=nonce, visitor=visitor, ref=new_ref(),
                  client_token=token if TOKEN.match(token) else "", email_status="queued",
                  fulfilment=data.get("fulfilment", ""), delivery_address=data.get("delivery_address", ""),
                  delivery_pin=data.get("delivery_pin", ""), wanted_date=data.get("wanted_date", ""),
                  time_slot=data.get("time_slot", ""), fee_inr=data.get("fee_inr", 0),
                  payment_terms=data.get("payment_terms", ""), pay_now_inr=data.get("pay_now_inr", 0),
                  pay_later_inr=data.get("pay_later_inr", 0))
    session.add(order)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(order)
    audit.record(session, actor="checker" if is_test else "customer", action="order_placed", target=f"order:{order.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=business.id,  # never the address, PIN or phone: only counts and the mode
                 detail=f"{len(data['items'])} item(s), total {data['total_inr']}"
                 + (f", {data['fulfilment']}" if data.get("fulfilment") else ""))

    recipients = order_recipients(session, settings, business)
    orders_url = f"{settings.app_base_url.rstrip('/')}/#/b/{business.id}/orders"
    subject, body = order_email(business, profile, order, data["items"], confirm_url, orders_url)
    kind = "test_order" if is_test else "order"
    outbox.send(session, settings, mailer, kind=kind, key=f"order:{order.id}", to=", ".join(recipients),
                subject=subject, body=body, channel=channel, business_id=business.id, order_id=order.id,
                # a test order that can't go out soon is useless (the next check sends a new one)
                expires_at=utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=30) if is_test else None,
                ref={"audit": {"actor": "system", "action": "order_email", "target": f"order:{order.id}"}})
    session.refresh(order)
    return order


def accept_order_form(session: Session, settings: Settings, mailer: Mailer, *, business: Business, profile: Profile,
                      form: dict[str, str], visitor: str, channel: str = "smtp") -> tuple[int, str]:
    """What the shop's order form does with a POST: (HTTP status, page HTML). The public route and the
    checker's practice test order both come through here, so the test order exercises the real path.

    A POST carrying `lw_test=<nonce>` of an OPEN test ticket for this shop becomes a hidden test order
    (not counted in limits, not in the seller's list). Any other value is ignored."""
    from app import proof
    from app.sites.render import render_site

    token = form.get("order_token", "")
    again = existing_order(session, business, token)
    if again is not None:  # double tap / form sent twice: show the same thank-you, make nothing new
        return 200, render_site(profile, page="thanks", order=order_view(again))
    ticket = proof.open_ticket(session, business, form.get("lw_test", ""))  # the checker's own test order, or None
    shown = {"session": session, "business": business}
    if ticket is None and ful.on_break(profile):  # S15: refused politely here, not only in the page; the checker's test order is not
        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}", result="blocked",
                     business_id=business.id, detail="shop is taking a break")
        return 409, render_site(profile, form_error=ful.break_refusal(profile), form_values=form,
                                full_dates=full_days(session, business, profile))
    try:
        data = parse_order_form(form, profile, test=ticket is not None, session=session, business=business)
    except OrderInvalid as e:
        return 422, render_site(profile, form_error=str(e), form_values=form, full_dates=full_days(**shown, profile=profile))
    if ticket is None:
        try:
            check_order_limits(session, settings, business, visitor)
        except TooManyOrders:
            return 429, render_site(profile, form_error=TOO_MANY, form_values=form,
                                    full_dates=full_days(**shown, profile=profile))
        order = place_order(session, mailer, settings, business=business, profile=profile, data=data, visitor=visitor,
                            token=token, channel=channel)
    else:
        confirm_url = proof.issue_confirm_link(session, settings, ticket)
        order = place_order(session, mailer, settings, business=business, profile=profile, data=data, is_test=True,
                            nonce=ticket.nonce, visitor="", token=token, confirm_url=confirm_url, channel=channel)
        proof.ticket_used(session, ticket, order)
    return 200, render_site(profile, page="thanks", order=order_view(order))

223	def check_test_order(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
224	    """Order from the shop like a customer: open the public page, find the order form, post it with a
225	    one-time test code, then record each hop separately. Delivery is proven only by finding the email in
226	    an inbox we can read, or by the owner tapping "Yes, I got it"; a mail server's "accepted" is not delivery."""
227	    url = f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/"
228	    web = shop_web(ctx)
229	    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(ctx.business.profile_json)
230	    page = web.get(url)
231	    form = proof.find_order_form(page.html) if page.status == 200 else None
232	    if form is None:
233	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't open your order form for a test order.",
234	                       f"GET {url}: status {page.status} {page.error}".strip())
235	    index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(profile.products) if not x.addon), 0)
236	    field = f"qty_{index}"
237	    if field not in form.qty_fields:
238	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't find an item to order on your page.", f"{field} not in form")
239	    ticket = proof.new_ticket(ctx.session, ctx.business, ctx.run_id)
240	    started = utcnow()
241	    fields = {**form.hidden, **TEST_CUSTOMER, field: "1", "lw_test": ticket.nonce}
242	    sent = web.post(urljoin(url, form.action), fields)
243	    ctx.session.refresh(ticket)
244	    order = ctx.session.get(Order, ticket.order_id) if ticket.order_id else None
245	    if sent.status != 200 or order is None:
246	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form didn't accept a test order.",
247	                       f"POST {form.action}: status {sent.status} {sent.error}".strip())
248	    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "form_post", status_code=sent.status, nonce=ticket.nonce, source=web.source,
249	             server=sent.server, answer=f"order {order.ref}")
250	    sent_row = ctx.session.exec(select(Outbox).where(Outbox.key == f"order:{order.id}")).first()
251	    if order.email_status == "queued":  # S13: held back by our daily send budget (or not tried yet): our side
252	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works. Our test email is waiting its turn to be sent, "
253	                       "so we'll finish this check on the next round.",
254	                       f"order {order.ref}: test email queued ({sent_row.last_error if sent_row else 'not tried'})",
255	                       unfinished=True)
256	    if order.email_status != "sent" or sent_row is None or sent_row.status != "sent":
257	        return Outcome("test_order", False, "Your order form works, but we couldn't send the order email.",
258	                       f"order {order.ref}: mail server refused or unreachable"
259	                       f"{f' ({sent_row.last_error})' if sent_row and sent_row.last_error else ''}")
260	    fake = ctx.integ.fake
261	    # the outbox's real send result: the Message-ID the mail server accepted, and which try it was
262	    evidence(ctx, "test_order", "smtp_accepted", message_id=sent_row.message_id, nonce=ticket.nonce,
263	             server="pretend mail server" if fake else ctx.settings.smtp_host, source="our mail server",
264	             answer=f"outbox {sent_row.id}, try {sent_row.attempts}")
265	    recipients = [r.lower() for r in order_recipients(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.business)]
266	    readable = fake or ctx.settings.imap_user.lower() in recipients
267	    if not readable:  # her own inbox: only she can prove it arrived
268	        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. Tap “Yes, I got it” "
269	                       "in that email to prove it reached your inbox.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}",
270	                       waiting=True)
271	    gaps = list(INBOX_GAPS) if ctx.inbox_wait else []
272	    if gaps:
273	        run_waiting(ctx, "test_email")  # the report says what we're waiting for, so it doesn't look stuck
274	    try:
275	        while True:
276	            if ctx.integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=ticket.nonce, since=started - timedelta(minutes=2)):
277	                evidence(ctx, "test_order", "imap_seen", nonce=ticket.nonce,
278	                         server="pretend inbox" if fake else ctx.settings.imap_host, source=ctx.settings.imap_user)
279	                return Outcome("test_order", True, "A test order reached your inbox.",
280	                               f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} found")
281	            if not gaps:
282	                break
283	            ctx.integ.sleep(gaps.pop(0))
284	    finally:
285	        if ctx.inbox_wait:
286	            run_waiting(ctx, None)
287	    if not ctx.inbox_wait:  # S13 B (monitoring): "accepted" is recorded; "seen" is looked for in a later short pass
288	        ctx.pending_inbox.append({"nonce": ticket.nonce, "since": (started - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),
289	                                  "ref": order.ref})
290	        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. We'll look for it in "
291	                       "the inbox again in a minute.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}: accepted, "
292	                       "inbox looked at once, looking again later", waiting=True)
293	    return Outcome("test_order", False, "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.",
294	                   f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} not found in {ctx.settings.imap_user} "
295	                   f"after {INBOX_WAIT_S} s")

299	# then every 10 s, up to 120 s in all; it stops at the first look that finds it. (Scheduled monitoring doesn't wait
300	# here: it looks again in later passes, monitor/scheduler.py INBOX_PASSES.)
301	INBOX_WAIT_S = 120
302	INBOX_GAPS = (5,) * 6 + (10,) * 9
303	assert sum(INBOX_GAPS) == INBOX_WAIT_S

306	def run_waiting(ctx: Ctx, what: str | None) -> None:
307	    """Mark the running CheckRun as waiting for something (shown on the report), or clear the mark."""
308	    if not ctx.run_id:
309	        return
310	    run = ctx.session.get(CheckRun, ctx.run_id)
311	    if run is None or run.status != "running":
312	        return
313	    info = json.loads(run.info_json or "{}")
314	    if what:
315	        info["waiting_for"] = what
316	    else:
317	        info.pop("waiting_for", None)
318	    run.info_json = json.dumps(info)
319	    ctx.session.add(run)
320	    ctx.session.commit()

323	def check_settings_match(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
324	    """Monitoring (daily): every setting the launch wrote still has the value it wrote."""
325	    current = {}
326	    for zone in {c["zone"] for c in ctx.changes}:
327	        for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(zone):
328	            current.setdefault((zone, r["type"], r["name"]), set()).add(str(r.get("data", "")))
329	    changed = []
330	    for c in ctx.changes:
331	        want = {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in c["after"]}
332	        have = current.get((c["zone"], c["type"], c["name"]), set())
333	        ok = bool(have) if (c["deferred"] or DKIM_PENDING in want) else want <= have
334	        if not ok:
335	            changed.append(f"{c['type']} {c['name']}")
336	    ok = not changed
337	    return Outcome("settings_match", ok, "Your settings are the same as at launch." if ok else
338	                   "Some of your settings changed since launch.", f"changed: {changed}" if changed else "all match")

368	def outcome_of(ctx: Ctx, name: str) -> Outcome:
369	    try:
370	        return CHECKS[name](ctx)
371	    except CouldntCheck as e:
372	        return Outcome(name, False, OUR_SIDE, str(e), unfinished=True)
373	    except Exception as e:  # a check that crashes is a failed check, never a crash of the launch
374	        return Outcome(name, False, "We couldn't complete this check.", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300])

377	def run_check(ctx: Ctx, name: str, attempt: int = 0) -> Outcome:
378	    out = outcome_of(ctx, name)
379	    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, attempt)
380	    return out

383	WATCHDOG_TEXT = ("This check took too long, so we stopped waiting for it. We don't know yet; we'll try again on the "
384	                 "next round.")
385	
386	
387	def run_check_watched(engine, ctx: Ctx, name: str, seconds: float) -> Outcome:
388	    """S13 B: a per-check watchdog. The check runs in its own thread with its OWN database session and copies of
389	    the shop's rows, so if it overruns we can stop waiting safely: it's marked "couldn't finish" (never passed),
390	    and the late thread can't write proof (ctx.abandoned). Python can't stop a thread: the late call keeps going
391	    until its own timeout, but nobody waits for it."""
392	    import threading
393	
394	    from app.models import Business, Plan
395	
396	    own = Session(engine)
397	    wctx = Ctx(own, ctx.settings, ctx.integ, own.get(Plan, ctx.plan.id), own.get(Business, ctx.business.id),
398	               run_id=ctx.run_id, inbox_wait=ctx.inbox_wait)
399	    box: dict = {}
400	
401	    def work():
402	        try:
403	            box["out"] = outcome_of(wctx, name)
404	        finally:
405	            own.close()
406	
407	    t = threading.Thread(target=work, name=f"check-{name}-{ctx.business.id}", daemon=True)
408	    t.start()
409	    t.join(seconds)
410	    if t.is_alive() or "out" not in box:
411	        wctx.abandoned = True
412	        out = Outcome(name, False, WATCHDOG_TEXT, f"no answer within {seconds:.0f}s: stopped waiting", unfinished=True)
413	    else:
414	        out = box["out"]
415	        ctx.pending_inbox.extend(wctx.pending_inbox)
416	    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, 0)
417	    return out
418

420	def save(session: Session, ctx: Ctx, out: Outcome, attempt: int) -> None:
421	    session.add(CheckResult(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, run_id=ctx.run_id, check=out.check, passed=out.passed,
422	                            detail=json.dumps({"plain": out.plain, "detail": out.detail, "waiting": out.waiting,
423	                                               **({"unfinished": True} if out.unfinished else {})}),
424	                            attempt=attempt))
425	    if out.check.startswith("email_") and out.passed:
426	        evidence(ctx, out.check, "dns_answer", answer=out.detail[:200], server=dns_server(ctx),
427	                 source="authoritative nameserver")
428	    session.commit()
429	    audit.record(session, actor="checker", action=f"check_{out.check}", target=ctx.plan.site_host,
430	                 result="pass" if out.passed else "fail", business_id=ctx.business.id,
431	                 detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {out.detail}"[:500])
432	
433	
434	def run_all(ctx: Ctx) -> list[Outcome]:
435	    return [run_check(ctx, name) for name in checks_for(ctx)]
