116	def parse_order_form(form: dict[str, str], profile: Profile, *, test: bool = False, session: Session | None = None,
117	                     business: Business | None = None, today: date | None = None) -> dict:
118	    """Everything the customer sent, checked against the shop's own rules. Prices, fees and totals come ONLY from the
119	    profile: a price or fee field in the form is never read. `test` fills the fulfilment fields (see test_defaults) and
120	    leaves the date out; a customer's order must give them. Raises OrderInvalid with a message fit to show as-is."""
121	    if form.get("website"):  # honeypot field, hidden from people
122	        raise OrderInvalid("Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.")
123	    today = today or ful.today_ist()
124	    if test:
125	        form = {**test_defaults(profile), **{k: v for k, v in form.items() if v}}
126	    name = " ".join(form.get("customer_name", "").split())[:80]
127	    phone = form.get("customer_phone", "").strip()
128	    note = form.get("note", "").strip()[:1000]
129	    if profile.allow_item_message:
130	        message = " ".join(form.get("item_message", "").split())[:200]
131	        if message:
132	            note = f"Message on the item: {message}" + (f"\n{note}" if note else "")
133	    if not name:
134	        raise OrderInvalid("Please add your name so we know who the order is for.")
135	    if not re.fullmatch(r"\+?[\d\s-]{10,20}", phone) or len(re.sub(r"\D", "", phone)) < 10:
136	        raise OrderInvalid("Please add a phone number we can call or WhatsApp (at least 10 digits).")
137	    items = []
138	    for i, product in enumerate(profile.products):
139	        raw = form.get(f"qty_{i}", "0").strip() or "0"
140	        if not raw.isdigit() or int(raw) > MAX_QTY:
141	            raise OrderInvalid(f"Please enter a quantity between 0 and {MAX_QTY}.")
142	        if int(raw) > 0:
143	            items.append({"name": product.name, "qty": int(raw), "price_inr": product.price_inr,
144	                          "addon": product.addon})
145	    if not items and not note:
146	        raise OrderInvalid("Please choose at least one item, or tell us what you'd like in the note.")
147	    if items and all(it["addon"] for it in items):
148	        raise OrderInvalid("Extras go with another item. Please choose an item too.")
149	    for it in items:
150	        del it["addon"]
151	
152	    # --- how it gets to the customer
153	    o = ful.offers(profile)
154	    choices = [c for c, on in (("pickup", o["pickup"]), ("delivery", o["local"] or o["india"])) if on]
155	    fulfilment, address, pin = "", "", ""
156	    if choices:
157	        asked = form.get("fulfilment", "").strip()
158	        if not asked and len(choices) == 1:
159	            asked = choices[0]
160	        if asked not in choices:
161	            raise OrderInvalid("Please choose " + (" or ".join(c if c == "pickup" else "delivery" for c in choices)) + ".")
162	        fulfilment = asked
163	    if fulfilment == "delivery":
164	        address = clean_address(form.get("delivery_address", ""))
165	        pin = re.sub(r"\s", "", form.get("delivery_pin", ""))
166	        if len(address) < 6:
167	            raise OrderInvalid("Please add the address we should deliver to.")
168	        if not ful.PIN.fullmatch(pin):
169	            raise OrderInvalid("Please add your 6-digit PIN code.")
170	        if o["local"] and not ful.serves(profile, address, pin):
171	            raise OrderInvalid(delivery_refusal(profile))
172	
173	    # --- when
174	    wanted = ""
175	    raw_date = form.get("wanted_date", "").strip()
176	    if raw_date:
177	        day = ful.parse_date(raw_date)
178	        if day is None:
179	            raise OrderInvalid("Please pick the date you want your order by.")
180	        taken = orders_on(session, business.id, day.isoformat()) if session is not None and business is not None else 0
181	        if problem := ful.date_problem(profile, day, today, taken):
182	            raise OrderInvalid(problem)
183	        wanted = day.isoformat()
184	    elif ful.date_required(profile) and not test:
185	        raise OrderInvalid("Please pick the date you want your order by.")
186	    slot = " ".join(form.get("time_slot", "").split())
187	    if profile.time_slots and slot and slot not in profile.time_slots:
188	        raise OrderInvalid("Please pick one of the time slots on the list.")
189	    if not profile.time_slots:
190	        slot = ""
191	
192	    # --- the money, worked out here from the menu
193	    items_sum = ful.items_total(items)
194	    fee = ful.fee_for(profile, fulfilment, items_sum)
195	    total = items_sum + fee
196	    pay_now, pay_later = ful.pay_split(profile, total)
197	    return {"customer_name": name, "customer_phone": phone, "note": note, "items": items, "total_inr": total,
198	            "items_inr": items_sum, "fee_inr": fee, "fulfilment": fulfilment, "delivery_address": address,
199	            "delivery_pin": pin, "wanted_date": wanted, "time_slot": slot, "payment_terms": profile.payment_terms,
200	            "pay_now_inr": pay_now, "pay_later_inr": pay_later}

253	def order_recipients(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business) -> list[str]:
254	    """Who gets this shop's order emails. ONE place decides it, for customers' orders and for the
255	    checker's test order alike: the owner's verified sign-in address. That address was proven at
256	    sign-in and is proven again by the test order. The app's own mailbox is added only for shops
257	    we run ourselves, and stands in while a guest practice shop has no owner yet."""
258	    out = owner_emails(session, business.id)
259	    if not out or run_by_team(session, business.id):
260	        if settings.smtp_user.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in out}:
261	            out.append(settings.smtp_user)
262	    return out

265	REF_ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"  # no 0/O/1/I
266	
267	
268	def new_ref() -> str:
269	    """Public order reference: random, so it reveals no count and can't be guessed."""
270	    return "LW-" + "".join(secrets.choice(REF_ALPHABET) for _ in range(8))

278	    pass

281	def check_order_limits(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business, visitor: str) -> None:
282	    """Per visitor (hashed IP) per shop per hour, and per shop per day. Test orders don't count."""
283	    real = (Order.business_id == business.id, Order.is_test == False)  # noqa: E712
284	    now = utcnow()
285	    mine = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
286	        *real, Order.visitor == visitor, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(hours=1))).one()
287	    shop = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
288	        *real, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(days=1))).one()
289	    if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour or shop >= settings.orders_per_shop_per_day:
290	        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}",
291	                     result="blocked", business_id=business.id,
292	                     detail="visitor hourly limit" if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour else "shop daily limit")
293	        raise TooManyOrders

296	TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$")

299	def existing_order(session: Session, business: Business, token: str) -> Order | None:
300	    """The order already made with this form token (a double tap or a re-sent form), if any."""
301	    if not TOKEN.match(token):
302	        return None
303	    return session.exec(select(Order).where(Order.business_id == business.id, Order.client_token == token)).first()

306	def order_view(order: Order) -> dict:
307	    """What the thank-you page may show. Deliberately NOT the street address: that stays with the owner."""
308	    return {"customer_name": order.customer_name, "customer_phone": order.customer_phone, "note": order.note,
309	            "items": json.loads(order.items_json), "total_inr": order.total_inr, "ref": order.ref,
310	            "fulfilment": order.fulfilment, "delivery_pin": order.delivery_pin, "wanted_date": order.wanted_date,
311	            "time_slot": order.time_slot, "fee_inr": order.fee_inr, "payment_terms": order.payment_terms,
312	            "pay_now_inr": order.pay_now_inr, "pay_later_inr": order.pay_later_inr}

315	def place_order(session: Session, mailer: Mailer, settings: Settings, *, business: Business, profile: Profile,
316	                data: dict, is_test: bool = False, nonce: str = "", visitor: str = "", token: str = "",
317	                confirm_url: str = "", channel: str = "smtp") -> Order:
318	    """Store the order, then email it to `order_recipients` through the outbox. The launch check's test order and
319	    a customer's order both come through here, so a passing test order proves the real path.
320	
321	    S13: the order is saved first and its email queued; the outbox tries it at once and keeps retrying if the
322	    mail server is slow or down, so a customer's order is never lost. `email_status` follows the outbox row."""
323	    from app import outbox
324	
325	    order = Order(business_id=business.id, customer_name=data["customer_name"], customer_phone=data["customer_phone"],
326	                  items_json=json.dumps(data["items"], ensure_ascii=False), total_inr=data["total_inr"],
327	                  note=data["note"], is_test=is_test, nonce=nonce, visitor=visitor, ref=new_ref(),
328	                  client_token=token if TOKEN.match(token) else "", email_status="queued",
329	                  fulfilment=data.get("fulfilment", ""), delivery_address=data.get("delivery_address", ""),
330	                  delivery_pin=data.get("delivery_pin", ""), wanted_date=data.get("wanted_date", ""),
331	                  time_slot=data.get("time_slot", ""), fee_inr=data.get("fee_inr", 0),
332	                  payment_terms=data.get("payment_terms", ""), pay_now_inr=data.get("pay_now_inr", 0),
333	                  pay_later_inr=data.get("pay_later_inr", 0))
334	    session.add(order)
335	    session.commit()
336	    session.refresh(order)
337	    audit.record(session, actor="checker" if is_test else "customer", action="order_placed", target=f"order:{order.id}", result="ok",
338	                 business_id=business.id,  # never the address, PIN or phone: only counts and the mode
339	                 detail=f"{len(data['items'])} item(s), total {data['total_inr']}"
340	                 + (f", {data['fulfilment']}" if data.get("fulfilment") else ""))
341	
342	    recipients = order_recipients(session, settings, business)
343	    orders_url = f"{settings.app_base_url.rstrip('/')}/#/b/{business.id}/orders"
344	    subject, body = order_email(business, profile, order, data["items"], confirm_url, orders_url)
345	    kind = "test_order" if is_test else "order"
346	    outbox.send(session, settings, mailer, kind=kind, key=f"order:{order.id}", to=", ".join(recipients),
347	                subject=subject, body=body, channel=channel, business_id=business.id, order_id=order.id,
348	                # a test order that can't go out soon is useless (the next check sends a new one)
349	                expires_at=utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=30) if is_test else None,
350	                ref={"audit": {"actor": "system", "action": "order_email", "target": f"order:{order.id}"}})
351	    session.refresh(order)
352	    return order

355	def accept_order_form(session: Session, settings: Settings, mailer: Mailer, *, business: Business, profile: Profile,
356	                      form: dict[str, str], visitor: str, channel: str = "smtp") -> tuple[int, str]:
357	    """What the shop's order form does with a POST: (HTTP status, page HTML). The public route and the
358	    checker's practice test order both come through here, so the test order exercises the real path.
359	
360	    A POST carrying `lw_test=<nonce>` of an OPEN test ticket for this shop becomes a hidden test order
361	    (not counted in limits, not in the seller's list). Any other value is ignored."""
362	    from app import proof
363	    from app.sites.render import render_site
364	
365	    token = form.get("order_token", "")
366	    again = existing_order(session, business, token)
367	    if again is not None:  # double tap / form sent twice: show the same thank-you, make nothing new
368	        return 200, render_site(profile, page="thanks", order=order_view(again))
369	    ticket = proof.open_ticket(session, business, form.get("lw_test", ""))  # the checker's own test order, or None
370	    shown = {"session": session, "business": business}
371	    if ticket is None and ful.on_break(profile):  # S15: refused politely here, not only in the page; the checker's test order is not
372	        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}", result="blocked",
373	                     business_id=business.id, detail="shop is taking a break")
374	        return 409, render_site(profile, form_error=ful.break_refusal(profile), form_values=form,
375	                                full_dates=full_days(session, business, profile))
376	    try:
377	        data = parse_order_form(form, profile, test=ticket is not None, session=session, business=business)
378	    except OrderInvalid as e:
379	        return 422, render_site(profile, form_error=str(e), form_values=form, full_dates=full_days(**shown, profile=profile))
380	    if ticket is None:
381	        try:
382	            check_order_limits(session, settings, business, visitor)
383	        except TooManyOrders:
384	            return 429, render_site(profile, form_error=TOO_MANY, form_values=form,
385	                                    full_dates=full_days(**shown, profile=profile))
386	        order = place_order(session, mailer, settings, business=business, profile=profile, data=data, visitor=visitor,
387	                            token=token, channel=channel)
388	    else:
389	        confirm_url = proof.issue_confirm_link(session, settings, ticket)
390	        order = place_order(session, mailer, settings, business=business, profile=profile, data=data, is_test=True,
391	                            nonce=ticket.nonce, visitor="", token=token, confirm_url=confirm_url, channel=channel)
392	        proof.ticket_used(session, ticket, order)
393	    return 200, render_site(profile, page="thanks", order=order_view(order))

146	    def due(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
147	        """Which shops this tick checks: those whose slot it is, plus any that missed theirs (overdue)."""
148	        now = now or utcnow()
149	        minute = now.hour * 60 + now.minute
150	        ids = self.live_business_ids()
151	        out: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
152	        for kind, slots, at in (("daily", DAILY_SLOTS, minute), ("quick", QUICK_MINUTES, minute % QUICK_MINUTES)):
153	            last = self.last_runs(kind)
154	            out[kind] = [b for b in ids if self.slot(b, slots) == at
155	                         or (b in last and now - last[b] > OVERDUE[kind])]

159	    def tick(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict:
160	        due = self.due(now)
161	        got = {}
162	        for kind in ("daily", "quick"):
163	            if due[kind]:  # a beat waits at most most of a minute: a slow shop never makes the next beat skip
164	                got[kind] = self._round(kind, due[kind], deadline=self.tick_wait)

167	    def _round(self, kind: str, ids: list[int] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None) -> dict:
168	        """Live shops side by side in a small pool. A shop whose check blows up is recorded as "couldn't finish"
169	        (never as passed); a shop still running at the deadline is recorded as unfinished and nobody waits for it.
170	        A second round never stacks on one still running, and a shop is never checked twice at once."""
171	        if not self._round_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
172	            with Session(self.engine) as s:
173	                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_round", target=kind, result="skipped",
174	                             detail="the previous round is still running")
175	            return {"skipped_round": True}
176	        try:
177	            futures, busy = {}, []
178	            for bid in (self.live_business_ids() if ids is None else ids):
179	                with self._busy_lock:
180	                    if bid in self._busy:
181	                        busy.append(bid)
182	                        continue
183	                    self._busy.add(bid)
184	                futures[self.pool.submit(self._shop, bid, kind)] = bid
185	            _done, late = wait(futures, timeout=deadline or self.round_deadline[kind])
186	            for f in late:
187	                bid = futures[f]
188	                with Session(self.engine) as s:
189	                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_shop", target=f"business:{bid}", result="unfinished",
190	                                 business_id=bid, detail=f"{kind} check still running when the round ended")
191	            for bid in busy:
192	                with Session(self.engine) as s:
193	                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_shop", target=f"business:{bid}", result="skipped",
194	                                 business_id=bid, detail=f"{kind}: the previous check of this shop is still running")
195	            return {"checked": len(futures) - len(late), "unfinished": sorted(futures[f] for f in late),
196	                    "busy": sorted(busy)}
197	        finally:
198	            self._round_lock.release()

296	    def inbox_pass(self, business_id: int, run_id: int, item: dict, n: int) -> str:
297	        """Look for the daily test order in the inbox we can read. Found: proof (`imap_seen`, through the chain)
298	        and the run's test-order row says so. Still missing after the last look: the row says so and the usual
299	        re-check (blocking look, Doctor, alert) takes over. Returns "seen" | "later" | "missing" | "gone"."""
300	        from app import proof
301	        from app.models import CheckResult

303	        found = self._context(business_id)
304	        if found is None:
305	            return "gone"
306	        b, _plan = found
307	        integ = self.integ_for(b)
308	        since = datetime.fromisoformat(item["since"])
309	        seen = integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=item["nonce"], since=since)
310	        if not seen and n < INBOX_PASSES:
311	            self.schedule_inbox_pass(business_id, run_id, item, n + 1)
312	            return "later"
313	        with Session(self.engine) as s:
314	            row = s.exec(select(CheckResult).where(CheckResult.run_id == run_id, CheckResult.check == "test_order")
315	                         .order_by(CheckResult.id.desc())).first()

319	                          practice=bool(integ.fake or biz.practice), nonce=item["nonce"],
320	                          server="pretend inbox" if integ.fake else self.settings.imap_host,
321	                          source=self.settings.imap_user)
322	                plain, ok = "A test order reached your inbox.", True
323	                detail = f"order {item['ref']} code {item['nonce']} found (look {n})"
324	            else:
325	                plain, ok = "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.", False
326	                detail = f"order {item['ref']} code {item['nonce']} not found after {n} looks"
327	            if row is not None:
328	                row.passed, row.detail = ok, json.dumps({"plain": plain, "detail": detail, "waiting": False})
329	                s.add(row)
330	                if not ok:
331	                    run = s.get(CheckRun, run_id)
332	                    if run is not None:
333	                        run.passed = False
334	                        s.add(run)
335	                s.commit()
336	            audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="inbox_pass", target=f"run:{run_id}",
337	                         result="seen" if ok else "missing", business_id=business_id, detail=detail)
338	        if not ok:
339	            self.schedule_recheck(business_id, ["test_order"])
340	        return "seen" if ok else "missing"

342	    def check_alert(self, business_id: int, host: str, f) -> None:
343	        """One email per problem. A problem that keeps coming back (fail → fine → fail again within a day, or
344	        fixed by us too many times today) gets ONE "keeps breaking" email, then silence for the rest of the day."""
345	        since = utcnow() - FLAP_WINDOW
346	        with Session(self.engine) as s:
347	            rows = s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.key == f.check,
348	                                              Alert.kind.in_(("check_failed", "check_flapping")))).all()
349	            if any(a.kind == "check_failed" and a.resolved_at is None for a in rows):
350	                return  # already told, still open
351	            recent = [a for a in rows if proof_aware(a.created_at) >= since]
352	            came_back = any(a.kind == "check_failed" for a in recent)
353	            told_flapping = any(a.kind == "check_flapping" for a in recent)
354	            for a in rows:  # yesterday's "keeps breaking" no longer blocks a new one
355	                if a.kind == "check_flapping" and a.resolved_at is None and proof_aware(a.created_at) < since:
356	                    a.resolved_at = utcnow()
357	                    s.add(a)
358	            s.commit()
359	        if not (f.keeps_breaking or came_back):
360	            self.alert(business_id, "check_failed", f.check,
361	                       subject=f"Something needs attention on {host}",
362	                       body=(f"Hello,\n\nOur regular check of your website found a problem we couldn't fix by ourselves:\n\n"
363	                             f"  {f.plain}\n\nSign in to LaunchWitness and open your shop's report to see the details, and "
364	                             f"press \"Run checks now\" after any change.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))
365	            return
366	        note = "(already told today: keeps breaking)"
367	        if not told_flapping:
368	            why = ("We fixed it several times today and it broke again, so we've stopped fixing it automatically."
369	                   if f.keeps_breaking else "It was fine for a while and has now broken again.")
370	            if not self.alert(business_id, "check_flapping", f.check,
371	                              subject=f"Something keeps breaking on {host}",
372	                              body=(f"Hello,\n\nThis keeps breaking on your website:\n\n  {f.plain}\n\n{why} Something "
373	                                    "outside LaunchWitness is probably changing it back. Sign in to LaunchWitness and open "
374	                                    "your shop's report for the exact next step. We won't email you about this one again "
375	                                    "today.\n\n— LaunchWitness")):
376	                return  # couldn't send: nothing is marked, so the next round tries again
377	            note = "(in the keeps-breaking email)"
378	        with Session(self.engine) as s:  # keep the problem itself on record as open, without another email
379	            s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind="check_failed", key=f.check, sent_to=note))
380	            s.commit()

from app.agents.launch_check import AlreadyChecking, NotLaunched, latest_launched_plan, run_checks
from app.config import Settings
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import Alert, Business, CheckRun, utcnow
from app.safety.access import owner_emails

QUICK_MINUTES = 15
OUTBOX_SECONDS = 20  # S13: how often the outbox's sender job looks for due email
RECHECK_SECONDS = 60
SHOP_BUDGET = {"quick": 90, "daily": 300, "recheck": 300}  # seconds one shop may take in a round
# S13 B: one check may take at most this long before we stop waiting for it ("couldn't finish"). Above the padlock
# check's own 2-minute retry for a certificate being issued, so a real slow issue is still seen as a failure.
CHECK_WATCHDOG = 150
ROUND_DEADLINE = {"quick": 12 * 60, "daily": 40 * 60}  # a round stops waiting for a shop after this (it keeps going)
TICK_SECONDS = 60  # the scheduler beat: each tick checks only the shops whose slot it is
DAILY_SLOTS = 24 * 60  # one slot a minute through the day
OVERDUE = {"quick": timedelta(minutes=QUICK_MINUTES + 5), "daily": timedelta(hours=25)}
INBOX_PASS_SECONDS, INBOX_PASSES = 60, 3  # the test order's later inbox look: every minute, three times
FLAP_WINDOW = timedelta(days=1)
QUICK_CHECKS = ["site_points", "https"]
EMAIL_CHECKS = ["email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc"]  # read-only on shops under the app's domain
DOMAIN_WARN_DAYS = renewals.THRESHOLDS  # one set for everything a person renews (S10)
CERT_WARN_DAYS = renewals.CERT_THRESHOLDS


def daily_checks(mode: str) -> list[str]:
    # The daily test order carries a fresh code. For an inbox we can't read it proves "form accepted ->
    # mail server accepted" only (the report says so); delivery needs the owner's tap on that email.
    return QUICK_CHECKS + EMAIL_CHECKS + ["settings_match", "test_order"]


def proof_aware(when):
    """SQLite hands datetimes back without a timezone; ours are always UTC."""
    return when if when.tzinfo is not None else when.replace(tzinfo=utcnow().tzinfo)


class Monitor:
    def __init__(self, engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ_for: Callable[[Business], Integrations],
                 claude: Claude, scheduler: BackgroundScheduler | None = None, team: Integrations | None = None,
                 mailer_for: Callable | None = None):
        self.engine, self.settings, self.integ_for, self.claude = engine, settings, integ_for, claude
        self.team = team  # the server's own integrations: the app domain, the team mailbox, the app zone
        self.mailer_for = mailer_for  # S13: outbox channel -> mailer, for the sender job
        self.scheduler = scheduler or BackgroundScheduler(timezone="UTC")
        # S13 B: shops are checked side by side by a small pool (tests may scale these times down)
        self.budgets, self.check_seconds = dict(SHOP_BUDGET), CHECK_WATCHDOG
        self.round_deadline, self.inbox_pass_seconds = dict(ROUND_DEADLINE), INBOX_PASS_SECONDS
        self.tick_wait = TICK_SECONDS * 0.8
        self.pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, settings.monitor_workers), thread_name_prefix="monitor")
        self._round_lock, self._busy_lock = threading.Lock(), threading.Lock()
        self._busy: set[int] = set()  # shops being checked right now (never two checks of one shop at once)

    # ---------- scheduler wiring ----------

    def register(self) -> None:
        if self.mailer_for is not None:  # S13: the outbox's sender job (the same one process, its own short beat)
            self.scheduler.add_job(self.send_mail, "interval", seconds=OUTBOX_SECONDS, id="outbox_send",
                                   replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)
        # S13 B: one beat a minute; each shop has a stable slot, so the shops are spread over the 15 minutes
        # (and the day) instead of all starting at once
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.tick, "interval", seconds=TICK_SECONDS, id="monitor_tick",
                               replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)
        if self.team is not None:
            self.scheduler.add_job(self.watch_addresses, "interval", days=1, id="watch_addresses",
                                   replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)
            self.scheduler.add_job(self.team_renewals, "interval", days=1, id="team_renewals",
                                   replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)
            self.scheduler.add_job(self.zone_hygiene, "interval", days=1, id="zone_hygiene",
                                   replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.register()
        self.scheduler.start()

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self.scheduler.running:
            self.scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)
        self.pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

    def schedule_recheck(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> None:
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.recheck, "date", run_date=utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=RECHECK_SECONDS),
                               args=[business_id, names], id=f"recheck-{business_id}", replace_existing=True)

    # ---------- jobs ----------

    def send_mail(self) -> dict:
        return outbox.run_once(self.engine, self.settings, self.mailer_for)

    def live_business_ids(self) -> list[int]:
        """Shops to watch: live, not paused. Guest practice shops are short-lived and aren't watched."""
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            return list(s.exec(select(Business.id).where(Business.status == "live", Business.paused == False,  # noqa: E712
                                                         Business.guest_hash == "")).all())

    def run_quick(self) -> dict:
        return self._round("quick")

    def run_daily(self) -> dict:
        return self._round("daily")

    @staticmethod
    def slot(business_id: int, slots: int) -> int:
        """A stable per-shop offset (the same in every process and after restarts; Python's hash() isn't)."""
        return zlib.crc32(f"shop:{business_id}".encode()) % slots

    def last_runs(self, kind: str) -> dict[int, datetime]:
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            rows = s.exec(select(CheckRun.business_id, CheckRun.started_at).where(
                CheckRun.trigger == f"monitor_{kind}")).all()
        last: dict[int, datetime] = {}
        for bid, at in rows:
            at = proof_aware(at)
            if bid not in last or at > last[bid]:
                last[bid] = at
        return last

    def due(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
        """Which shops this tick checks: those whose slot it is, plus any that missed theirs (overdue)."""
        now = now or utcnow()
        minute = now.hour * 60 + now.minute
        ids = self.live_business_ids()
        out: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
        for kind, slots, at in (("daily", DAILY_SLOTS, minute), ("quick", QUICK_MINUTES, minute % QUICK_MINUTES)):
            last = self.last_runs(kind)
            out[kind] = [b for b in ids if self.slot(b, slots) == at
                         or (b in last and now - last[b] > OVERDUE[kind])]
        out["quick"] = [b for b in out["quick"] if b not in out["daily"]]  # daily includes the quick checks
        return out

    def tick(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict:
        due = self.due(now)
        got = {}
        for kind in ("daily", "quick"):
            if due[kind]:  # a beat waits at most most of a minute: a slow shop never makes the next beat skip
                got[kind] = self._round(kind, due[kind], deadline=self.tick_wait)
        return got

    def _round(self, kind: str, ids: list[int] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None) -> dict:
        """Live shops side by side in a small pool. A shop whose check blows up is recorded as "couldn't finish"
        (never as passed); a shop still running at the deadline is recorded as unfinished and nobody waits for it.
        A second round never stacks on one still running, and a shop is never checked twice at once."""
        if not self._round_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_round", target=kind, result="skipped",
                             detail="the previous round is still running")
            return {"skipped_round": True}
        try:
            futures, busy = {}, []
            for bid in (self.live_business_ids() if ids is None else ids):
                with self._busy_lock:
                    if bid in self._busy:
                        busy.append(bid)
                        continue
                    self._busy.add(bid)
                futures[self.pool.submit(self._shop, bid, kind)] = bid
            _done, late = wait(futures, timeout=deadline or self.round_deadline[kind])
            for f in late:
                bid = futures[f]
                with Session(self.engine) as s:
                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_shop", target=f"business:{bid}", result="unfinished",
                                 business_id=bid, detail=f"{kind} check still running when the round ended")
            for bid in busy:
                with Session(self.engine) as s:
                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_shop", target=f"business:{bid}", result="skipped",
                                 business_id=bid, detail=f"{kind}: the previous check of this shop is still running")
            return {"checked": len(futures) - len(late), "unfinished": sorted(futures[f] for f in late),
                    "busy": sorted(busy)}
        finally:
            self._round_lock.release()

    def _shop(self, bid: int, kind: str) -> None:
        try:
            self.check_business(bid, kind)
        except Exception as e:
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="monitor_shop", target=f"business:{bid}", result="failed",
                             business_id=bid, detail=f"{kind} check couldn't finish: {type(e).__name__}")
        finally:
            with self._busy_lock:
                self._busy.discard(bid)

    def _context(self, business_id: int):
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            b = s.get(Business, business_id)
            plan = latest_launched_plan(s, business_id) if b else None
            if b is None or plan is None:
                return None
            s.expunge_all()
            return b, plan

    def check_business(self, business_id: int, kind: str) -> list[str]:
        """Run the quick or daily checks without fixing. Returns the failing check names."""
        found = self._context(business_id)
        if found is None:
            return []
        b, plan = found
        names = QUICK_CHECKS if kind == "quick" else daily_checks(plan.mode)
        try:
            summary = run_checks(self.engine, self.settings, self.integ_for(b), self.claude, plan.id,
                                 trigger=f"monitor_{kind}", names=names, fix=False,
                                 budget_seconds=self.budgets[kind], check_seconds=self.check_seconds,
                                 inbox_wait=False)
        except (NotLaunched, AlreadyChecking):  # e.g. the owner just pressed "Run checks now": skip this round
            return []
        # "couldn't finish" / "our lookup failed" is not a failure of the shop: no re-check as one, no alert,
        # and it doesn't clear an open alert either (we simply don't know)
        failing = [f.check for f in summary.failed if not f.unfinished]
        if failing:
            self.schedule_recheck(business_id, failing)
        for item in summary.inbox:  # S13 B: "accepted" is recorded; look for "seen" in a short later pass
            self.schedule_inbox_pass(business_id, summary.run_id, item, 1)
        self.resolve(business_id, [n for n in names if n not in {f.check for f in summary.failed}])
        if kind == "daily":
            self.expiry_alerts(business_id, summary.run_id)
            self.public_resolvers(business_id, summary.run_id, plan.site_host)
        return failing

    def public_resolvers(self, business_id: int, run_id: int | None, host: str) -> dict | None:
        """S13b: the daily run also asks three public resolvers; saved as evidence, never alerted on."""
        from app.agents.checker import public_resolvers

        if not run_id:
            return None
        try:
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                biz = s.get(Business, business_id)
                if biz is None:
                    return None
                got = public_resolvers(s, biz, run_id, host, self.settings.server_ip, self.integ_for(biz))
                if got is not None:
                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="public_resolvers", target=host,
                                 result="ok" if got["agree"] == got["asked"] else "differs", business_id=business_id,
                                 detail=f"{got['agree']} of {got['asked']} agree")
                return got
        except Exception as e:  # information only: it never breaks the round
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="public_resolvers", target=host, result="failed",
                             business_id=business_id, detail=type(e).__name__)
            return None

    def recheck(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        """A minute later: re-check; the Doctor fixes what it safely can; alert on what's left."""
        found = self._context(business_id)
        if found is None:
            return []
        b, plan = found
        try:
            summary = run_checks(self.engine, self.settings, self.integ_for(b), self.claude, plan.id,
                                 trigger="monitor_recheck", names=names, fix=True,
                                 budget_seconds=self.budgets["recheck"], check_seconds=self.check_seconds)
        except (NotLaunched, AlreadyChecking):
            return []
        still = [f for f in summary.failed if not f.unfinished]
        self.resolve(business_id, [n for n in names if n not in {f.check for f in summary.failed}])
        for f in still:
            self.check_alert(business_id, plan.site_host, f)
        return [f.check for f in still]

    # ---------- S13 B: the test order's later inbox look ----------

    def schedule_inbox_pass(self, business_id: int, run_id: int, item: dict, n: int) -> None:
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.inbox_pass, "date",
                               run_date=utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=self.inbox_pass_seconds),
                               args=[business_id, run_id, item, n], id=f"inbox-{business_id}-{item['nonce']}",
                               replace_existing=True)

    def inbox_pass(self, business_id: int, run_id: int, item: dict, n: int) -> str:
        """Look for the daily test order in the inbox we can read. Found: proof (`imap_seen`, through the chain)
        and the run's test-order row says so. Still missing after the last look: the row says so and the usual
        re-check (blocking look, Doctor, alert) takes over. Returns "seen" | "later" | "missing" | "gone"."""
        from app import proof
        from app.models import CheckResult

        found = self._context(business_id)
        if found is None:
            return "gone"
        b, _plan = found
        integ = self.integ_for(b)
        since = datetime.fromisoformat(item["since"])
        seen = integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=item["nonce"], since=since)
        if not seen and n < INBOX_PASSES:
            self.schedule_inbox_pass(business_id, run_id, item, n + 1)
            return "later"
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            row = s.exec(select(CheckResult).where(CheckResult.run_id == run_id, CheckResult.check == "test_order")
                         .order_by(CheckResult.id.desc())).first()
            biz = s.get(Business, business_id)
            if seen:
                proof.add(s, business=biz, run_id=run_id, check="test_order", step="imap_seen",
                          practice=bool(integ.fake or biz.practice), nonce=item["nonce"],
                          server="pretend inbox" if integ.fake else self.settings.imap_host,
                          source=self.settings.imap_user)
                plain, ok = "A test order reached your inbox.", True
                detail = f"order {item['ref']} code {item['nonce']} found (look {n})"
            else:
                plain, ok = "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.", False
                detail = f"order {item['ref']} code {item['nonce']} not found after {n} looks"
            if row is not None:
                row.passed, row.detail = ok, json.dumps({"plain": plain, "detail": detail, "waiting": False})
                s.add(row)
                if not ok:
                    run = s.get(CheckRun, run_id)
                    if run is not None:
                        run.passed = False
                        s.add(run)
                s.commit()
            audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="inbox_pass", target=f"run:{run_id}",
                         result="seen" if ok else "missing", business_id=business_id, detail=detail)
        if not ok:
            self.schedule_recheck(business_id, ["test_order"])
        return "seen" if ok else "missing"

    def check_alert(self, business_id: int, host: str, f) -> None:
        """One email per problem. A problem that keeps coming back (fail → fine → fail again within a day, or
        fixed by us too many times today) gets ONE "keeps breaking" email, then silence for the rest of the day."""
        since = utcnow() - FLAP_WINDOW
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            rows = s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.key == f.check,
                                              Alert.kind.in_(("check_failed", "check_flapping")))).all()
            if any(a.kind == "check_failed" and a.resolved_at is None for a in rows):
                return  # already told, still open
            recent = [a for a in rows if proof_aware(a.created_at) >= since]
            came_back = any(a.kind == "check_failed" for a in recent)
            told_flapping = any(a.kind == "check_flapping" for a in recent)
            for a in rows:  # yesterday's "keeps breaking" no longer blocks a new one
                if a.kind == "check_flapping" and a.resolved_at is None and proof_aware(a.created_at) < since:
                    a.resolved_at = utcnow()
                    s.add(a)
            s.commit()
        if not (f.keeps_breaking or came_back):
            self.alert(business_id, "check_failed", f.check,
                       subject=f"Something needs attention on {host}",
                       body=(f"Hello,\n\nOur regular check of your website found a problem we couldn't fix by ourselves:\n\n"
                             f"  {f.plain}\n\nSign in to LaunchWitness and open your shop's report to see the details, and "
                             f"press \"Run checks now\" after any change.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))
            return
        note = "(already told today: keeps breaking)"
        if not told_flapping:
            why = ("We fixed it several times today and it broke again, so we've stopped fixing it automatically."
                   if f.keeps_breaking else "It was fine for a while and has now broken again.")
            if not self.alert(business_id, "check_flapping", f.check,
                              subject=f"Something keeps breaking on {host}",
                              body=(f"Hello,\n\nThis keeps breaking on your website:\n\n  {f.plain}\n\n{why} Something "
                                    "outside LaunchWitness is probably changing it back. Sign in to LaunchWitness and open "
                                    "your shop's report for the exact next step. We won't email you about this one again "
                                    "today.\n\n— LaunchWitness")):
                return  # couldn't send: nothing is marked, so the next round tries again
            note = "(in the keeps-breaking email)"
        with Session(self.engine) as s:  # keep the problem itself on record as open, without another email
            s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind="check_failed", key=f.check, sent_to=note))
            s.commit()

    # ---------- alerts ----------

    def resolve(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            for a in s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == "check_failed",
                                                Alert.resolved_at == None)).all():  # noqa: E711
                if a.key in names:
                    a.resolved_at = utcnow()
                    s.add(a)
            s.commit()

    def alert(self, business_id: int, kind: str, key: str, *, subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
        """Email the owner's personal address once per (kind, key) until resolved. True if sent."""
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            b = s.get(Business, business_id)
            open_ = s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                               Alert.key == key, Alert.resolved_at == None)).first()  # noqa: E711
            if open_ is not None:
                return False
            to = ", ".join(owner_emails(s, business_id))
            if not to:
                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action=f"alert_{kind}", target=key, result="skipped",
                             business_id=business_id, detail="the shop has no signed-in owner")
                return False
            # S13: through the outbox. The key counts earlier alerts of this kind, so a problem that was
            # resolved and came back is a new email, while the same open problem is never emailed twice.
            # Not sent at once: the outbox keeps trying, and each monitoring round also tries it again.
            integ = self.integ_for(b)
            told = len(s.exec(select(Alert.id).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                                      Alert.key == key)).all())
            row = outbox.send(s, self.settings, integ.mailer, kind="alert", retry_now=True,
                              key=f"alert:{business_id}:{kind}:{key}:{told}", to=to, subject=subject, body=body,
                              channel=outbox.channel_of(integ), business_id=business_id,
                              ref={"audit": {"actor": "monitor", "action": f"alert_{kind}", "target": key}})
            if row.status != "sent":
                return False
            s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind=kind, key=key, sent_to=to))
            s.commit()
            return True

    def expiry_alerts(self, business_id: int, run_id: int) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            run = s.get(CheckRun, run_id)
            info = json.loads(run.info_json) if run else {}
        self._expiry(business_id, "domain_expiry", info.get("domain_days_left"), DOMAIN_WARN_DAYS,
                     lambda d: (f"Your website name ends in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}",
                                f"Hello,\n\nYour website name (domain) runs out in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}. "
                                "Renewing it costs money, so we won't do it for you. Please renew it on godaddy.com "
                                "before then, or your website and order emails will stop working.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))
        self._expiry(business_id, "cert_expiry", info.get("cert_days_left"), CERT_WARN_DAYS,
                     lambda d: (f"Your website's security certificate ends in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}",
                                f"Hello,\n\nYour website's security certificate (the padlock) runs out in {d} "
                                f"day{'s' if d != 1 else ''} and hasn't renewed itself yet. It costs nothing and you "
                                "don't need to do anything — we're looking into it.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))

    def _expiry(self, business_id: int, kind: str, days: int | None, thresholds: tuple[int, ...], text) -> None:
        if days is None:
            return
        crossed = [t for t in thresholds if days <= t]
        if not crossed:  # renewed (or far away): clear old warnings so the next cycle warns again
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                for a in s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                                    Alert.resolved_at == None)).all():  # noqa: E711
                    a.resolved_at = utcnow()
                    s.add(a)
                s.commit()
            return
        nearest = min(crossed)
        subject, body = text(max(days, 0))
        if self.alert(business_id, kind, f"{nearest}d", subject=subject, body=body):
            with Session(self.engine) as s:  # skip the bigger thresholds we're already past
                for t in crossed:
                    seen = s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                                      Alert.key == f"{t}d", Alert.resolved_at == None)).first()  # noqa: E711
                    if t != nearest and seen is None:
                        s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind=kind, key=f"{t}d", sent_to="(skipped)"))
                s.commit()


    def watch_addresses(self) -> int:
        """S10.5b: read-only daily checks of the addresses users asked us to watch; one email per new problem,
        sent from the team mailbox to the user's own sign-in address."""
        from app import watch
        from app.checks.safe_fetch import SafeWeb
        from app.routers.proof import get_public_dns

        return watch.run_daily(self.engine, self.team.mailer, get_public_dns(), SafeWeb(lambda _h: True, timeout=8.0),
                               channel=outbox.channel_of(self.team), settings=self.settings)

    # ---------- the team's own renewals (S10): the app domain and the team mailbox ----------

    def team_renewals(self, today=None) -> list[str]:
        """Email ADMIN_EMAIL at 30 / 7 / 1 days before the app domain or the team mailbox runs out. Never renews
        or pays: both cost money, so a person decides. Returns the alert keys sent this time."""
        from datetime import date

        from app.agents.launch_check import days_left
        from app.models import TeamAlert

        domain_days = None
        if self.team is not None:
            try:
                domain_days = days_left(self.team.godaddy.domain_expires(self.settings.app_domain))
            except Exception as e:  # informational; try again tomorrow
                with Session(self.engine) as s:
                    audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action="team_renewals", target=self.settings.app_domain,
                                 result="failed", detail=type(e).__name__)
        sent: list[str] = []
        for kind, days, what in (
                ("app_domain_expiry", domain_days, f"the app domain {self.settings.app_domain}"),
                ("mailbox_expiry", renewals.mailbox_days(self.settings, today or date.today()),
                 f"the team mailbox {self.settings.smtp_user} (sign-in links, orders and alerts all use it)")):
            hit = renewals.crossed(days, renewals.THRESHOLDS)
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                open_ = s.exec(select(TeamAlert).where(TeamAlert.kind == kind, TeamAlert.resolved_at == None)).all()  # noqa: E711
                if not hit:  # renewed (or far away): the next cycle warns again
                    for a in open_:
                        a.resolved_at = utcnow()
                        s.add(a)
                    s.commit()
                    continue
                key = f"{min(hit)}d"
                if any(a.key == key for a in open_):
                    continue  # this threshold was already sent
                to = self.settings.admin_email.strip()
                subject = f"LaunchWitness: {what.split(' (')[0]} runs out in {max(days, 0)} day(s)"
                body = (f"Hello team,\n\n{what[0].upper() + what[1:]} runs out in {max(days, 0)} day(s). "
                        "Renewing costs money, so LaunchWitness won't do it: please renew it on godaddy.com.\n\n"

Used after a launch finishes, by "Run checks now", and by monitoring. Used for ONE practice check run only.""" def send(self, *, to: str, subject: str, body: str, html: str | None = None) -> str: raise smtplib.SMTPAuthenticationError(535, b"staged fault: sign-in refused") def login_test(self) -> str: return "login refused: the mail service did not accept our sign-in" class StagedCertProbe: """Staged fault: the shop's certificate isn't working until it is asked for again (`staged_heal`, called by the playbook's retry_certificate). This domain is parked

SYMPTOMS_PER_DAY = 5  # per signed-in user (or guest workspace): each one can wake the Doctor


class Symptom(BaseModel):
    symptom: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)


def symptoms_today(session: Session, actor) -> int:
    who = f"user:{actor.user_id}" if actor.user_id else f"guest:{actor.guest[:16]}"
    return len(session.exec(select(AuditEvent.id).where(
        AuditEvent.action == "describe_problem", AuditEvent.target == who, AuditEvent.result == "ok",
        AuditEvent.created_at >= utcnow() - timedelta(days=1))).all())


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/describe-problem", status_code=202)
def describe_problem(body: Symptom, background: BackgroundTasks, actor: ActorDep,
                     b: Annotated[Business, Depends(require_business_access)],
                     settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                     session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                     claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
                     integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    """"Describe the problem" (S12): the owner's own words start a check run, and are handed to the Doctor as
    DATA (fenced, labelled, never instructions) for any check that fails. Limited per user per day."""
    plan = latest_launched_plan(session, b.id)
    if plan is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Your business isn't launched yet, so there's nothing to check.")
    who = f"user:{actor.user_id}" if actor.user_id else f"guest:{actor.guest[:16]}"
    if symptoms_today(session, actor) >= SYMPTOMS_PER_DAY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail=f"You've described {SYMPTOMS_PER_DAY} problems today. "
                            "Please try again tomorrow, or write to us from the contact form.")
    words = " ".join(body.symptom.split())[:500]
    try:
        run = start_run(session, b.id, plan.id, "manual")
    except AlreadyChecking:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="We're already checking. This takes a few seconds.") from None
    # The words themselves aren't written to the audit log (they may hold a customer's name); only their length.
    audit.record(session, actor=actor.label, action="describe_problem", target=who, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id, detail=f"run #{run.id}, {len(words)} characters")
    background.add_task(run_checks, session.get_bind(), settings, integ_for(plan), claude, plan.id,
                        trigger="manual", run_id=run.id, symptom=words)
    return {"ok": True, "run_id": run.id}

"""Watch an address (S10.5b): the same read-only public checks as "Check any address", once a day, for up to
WATCH_LIMIT addresses per signed-in account, with one email per NEW problem.

What it never does: submit forms, send email to that domain, or change anything there. It reads public DNS and
opens the home page over HTTPS through the SSRF-safe fetcher (`SafeWeb`), exactly like the public tool. The only
email goes to the account's own sign-in address.
"""

import json
from datetime import timedelta

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app import audit, outbox
from app.checks.dns_resolver import DnsResolver
from app.checks.safe_fetch import SafeWeb
from app.config import get_settings
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer
from app.models import AuditEvent, Outbox, User, WatchedAddress, utcnow

WATCH_LIMIT = 3  # addresses per account
ADDS_PER_DAY = 10  # adding (each add runs one check right away): rate limit per account


def problems_of(results: list[dict]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """{check: plain sentence} for every check that failed (unknowns don't count)."""
    return {r["check"]: r["plain"] for r in results if r.get("ok") is False}


def check_now(session: Session, w: WatchedAddress, dns: DnsResolver, web: SafeWeb) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Run the read-only checks for one watch and store the result. Returns the NEW problems (not seen last time)."""
    from app.routers.proof import address_results

    results = address_results(w.host, dns, web)
    now_bad = problems_of(results)
    before = set(json.loads(w.problems_json or "[]"))
    new = {k: v for k, v in now_bad.items() if k not in before}
    w.problems_json = json.dumps(sorted(now_bad))
    w.results_json = json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False)

content.text:
Here is the Part A audit, from the code as it stands at `a7b307e`:

| Trigger | Test-order email? | To whom | How often | Subject / first line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Launch** | Yes | `order_recipients`: the seller's sign-in address (plus hello@ only for team-run shops; hello@ alone for an ownerless guest practice shop) | once | `[TEST] New order for {shop} from LaunchWitness test (LW-…) [nonce]` / "New order LW-… for {shop}", then "This is an automatic test order…" |
| **"Check again"** | Yes | same | each press | same |
| **"Describe the problem"** | Yes (it's a full run) | same | ≤5/day | same |
| **Daily monitoring** | **Yes** | **the seller** | **every day** | same |
| **Monitoring re-check** (a minute after a daily failure, if `test_order` failed) | **Yes** | **the seller** | per failure | same |
| **15-minute quick check** | No (only address + padlock) | – | – | – |
| **Team demo switch** | No email of its own. It arms a fault for the *next* run (normally the team's "Run checks now") | same as Check again | one-shot | same |
| **Watched addresses** | No (read-only; never submits forms) | the watcher gets an alert only for a *new* problem | daily | – |

What a test order touches:
- **Orders page / "N new orders":** hidden in both (`is_test == False` filters in `list_orders`, `new_orders` and status changes).
- **Orders-per-day limit / blocked dates:** not counted (`orders_on`, `full_days` and `check_order_limits` all exclude tests).
- **`SMTP_DAILY_LIMIT`:** **counted.** Every real SMTP send counts in `sent_today`. Test emails are the lowest priority (2), so they are held first and never crowd out orders or sign-in links.
- **New-order template:** **yes.** Tests use the same `order_email`, so they include the customer `tel:` and WhatsApp links (to the fake 0000000000 number, which yields a `tel:` link) and the "New order" wording.
- **Repeated alerts:** no. `check_alert` sends one email per open problem, and only again after it resolves and comes back; a problem that comes back within a day gets one "keeps breaking" email. Watched addresses also email only on *new* problems.

So there are two conflicts with the rule. The daily run and its re-check email the seller, and test emails look like real orders. One extra catch: a daily test sent to hello@ must **not** carry a "Yes, I got it" link. If it did, someone tapping it in hello@ would write `owner_confirmed` evidence, which would be false. Moving on to Part B.

    recipients = [r.lower() for r in test_recipients(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.business, audience)]
    readable = fake or ctx.settings.imap_user.lower() in recipients
    where = "LaunchWitness's check mailbox" if audience == "check" else "your inbox"
    if not readable:  # her own inbox: only she can prove it arrived
        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order for you. Tap “Yes, I got it” "
                       "in that email to prove it reached your inbox.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}",
                       waiting=True)
    gaps = list(INBOX_GAPS) if ctx.inbox_wait else []
    if gaps:
        run_waiting(ctx, "test_email")  # the report says what we're waiting for, so it doesn't look stuck
    try:
        while True:
            if ctx.integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=ticket.nonce, since=started - timedelta(minutes=2)):
                evidence(ctx, "test_order", "imap_seen", nonce=ticket.nonce,
                         server="pretend inbox" if fake else ctx.settings.imap_host, source=ctx.settings.imap_user,
                         **({"answer": proof.CHECK_MAILBOX} if audience == "check" else {}))
                return Outcome("test_order", True, seen_text(audience), f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} found",
                               mailbox=audience)
            if not gaps:
                break
            ctx.integ.sleep(gaps.pop(0))
    finally:
        if ctx.inbox_wait:
            run_waiting(ctx, None)
    if not ctx.inbox_wait:  # S13 B (monitoring): "accepted" is recorded; "seen" is looked for in a later short pass
        ctx.pending_inbox.append({"nonce": ticket.nonce, "since": (started - timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),
                                  "ref": order.ref, "mailbox": audience})
        return Outcome("test_order", True, "The mail server accepted a test order. We'll look for it in "
                       f"{where} again in a minute.", f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce}: accepted, "
                       "inbox looked at once, looking again later", waiting=True, mailbox=audience)
    return Outcome("test_order", False, missing_text(audience),
                   f"order {order.ref} code {ticket.nonce} not found in {ctx.settings.imap_user} "
                   f"after {INBOX_WAIT_S} s", mailbox=audience)


def seen_text(audience: str) -> str:
    """S19B: honest about WHICH inbox: a monitoring test is proven in our check mailbox, never in hers."""
    if audience == "check":
        return ("Our daily test order reached LaunchWitness's check mailbox: your order form and our sending work. "
                "(Your own inbox is checked at launch and whenever you press “Run checks now”.)")
    return "A test order reached your inbox."


def missing_text(audience: str) -> str:
    if audience == "check":
        return "Our daily test order was sent but hasn't arrived in LaunchWitness's check mailbox."
    return "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox."

"""Session 9F, Phase 1: make the current claims true (audit B1-B9, S2, S5-S8, app-zone guard)."""

import json
from datetime import timedelta

import httpx
import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.agents.checker import checks_for, run_check
from app.agents.launch_check import AlreadyChecking, start_run
from app.agents.playbook import fixes_for
from app.godaddy.client import AppZoneWriteRefused, FakeGoDaddyClient, GoDaddyClient

from app.mail.providers import PROVIDERS
from app.models import AuditEvent, Business, CheckRun, Order, Plan, utcnow
from app.routers.internal import is_allowed_tls_domain
from app.sites.orders import order_recipients
from app.startup import reconcile
from tests.conftest import pickup, publish, sign_in
from tests.test_m3_launch import approve, meera, plan
from tests.test_m4_repair import ctx_for

HOST = {"host": "meera.localhost"}
ORDER = {"qty_0": "1", "customer_name": "Asha Rao", "customer_phone": "98765 43210", **pickup()}


def launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email: str | None = None) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """A sandbox-launched, public (live, not practice) shop at meera.localhost."""
    if owner_email:
        sign_in(client, owner_email)
    biz = meera(client)
    p = approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    assert p["status"] == "done", p["steps"]
    publish(engine, biz["id"])
    return biz, p


# ---------- B1: orders go to the right person, same function + recipients as the test order ----------

def test_b1_real_and_test_orders_share_recipients(client, engine, integ, settings):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email="meera@example.org")
    test_mail = next(m for m in integ.mailer.sent if "TEST, not a real order:" in m["subject"])
    r = client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    real_mail = integ.mailer.sent[-1]
    assert "TEST, not a real order:" not in real_mail["subject"]
    assert real_mail["to"] == test_mail["to"] == "meera@example.org"  # her verified sign-in address, nobody else
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert order_recipients(s, settings, s.get(Business, biz["id"])) == ["meera@example.org"]


def test_b1_guest_practice_orders_stay_in_the_app_mailbox_and_team_shops_get_both(client, new_client, engine, settings):
    biz = meera(client)  # guest: no owner yet
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert order_recipients(s, settings, s.get(Business, biz["id"])) == [settings.smtp_user]
    from app.models import Membership, User

    with Session(engine) as s:  # a shop the team runs itself
        admin = User(email="team@example.org", status="approved", role="admin")

"""Session 19B: a seller only gets a test email when she asked for one, and a test never looks like an order.

- launch, "Run checks now" and "Describe the problem" send the test to the shop's order address (she asked);
- the daily run (and its re-check) sends it to LaunchWitness's own check mailbox, never to the seller, with no
  "Yes, I got it" link, and the report says "check mailbox", never "your inbox";
- every test email: subject starts with "TEST, not a real order:" (the one-time code kept), body opens with the
  grey "This is a check" banner, no call / WhatsApp buttons; real order emails are unchanged;
- test orders stay out of the Orders page, the "new" count and the daily capacity;
- one alert per problem.
"""

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import chain
from app.mail import layout
from app.models import Alert, CheckResult, CheckRun, Evidence, Order, Outbox, TestTicket
from app.monitor.scheduler import Monitor
from app.sites.orders import TEST_BANNER, TEST_SUBJECT, test_audience
from tests.test_s9_phase1 import HOST, ORDER, launched_shop

OWNER = "meera@example.org"


def tests_sent(integ) -> list[dict]:
    return [m for m in integ.mailer.sent if m["subject"].startswith(TEST_SUBJECT)]


def sent_rows(engine, kind: str) -> list[Outbox]:
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return list(s.exec(select(Outbox).where(Outbox.kind == kind).order_by(Outbox.id)).all())


def monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude) -> Monitor:
    return Monitor(engine, settings, lambda _b: integ, claude)


def last_result(engine, bid: int, trigger_prefix: str) -> dict:
    import json

    with Session(engine) as s:
        row = s.exec(select(CheckResult).join(CheckRun, CheckRun.id == CheckResult.run_id).where(
            CheckResult.business_id == bid, CheckResult.check == "test_order",
            CheckRun.trigger.like(f"{trigger_prefix}%")).order_by(CheckResult.id.desc())).first()
        return json.loads(row.detail) | {"passed": row.passed, "run_id": row.run_id}


# ---------- who gets it ----------

def test_audience_by_trigger():
    assert test_audience("launch") == test_audience("manual") == ""
    assert test_audience("monitor_daily") == test_audience("monitor_recheck") == "check"


def test_launch_sends_the_test_to_the_seller_once(client, engine, integ):
    launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    (mail,) = tests_sent(integ)
    assert mail["to"] == OWNER
    assert "/#/got-it?token=" in mail["body"]  # she can prove her own inbox got it


def test_run_checks_now_and_describe_the_problem_go_to_the_seller(client, engine, integ):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks").status_code == 202
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/describe-problem",
                       json={"symptom": "my customer says the page won't open"}).status_code == 202
    sent = tests_sent(integ)
    assert len(sent) == 3 and all(m["to"] == OWNER for m in sent)
    assert all("/#/got-it?token=" in m["body"] for m in sent)


def test_daily_run_sends_the_test_to_our_check_mailbox_never_the_seller(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    before = len(integ.mailer.sent)
    assert monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude).check_business(biz["id"], "daily") == []
    new = integ.mailer.sent[before:]
    (mail,) = [m for m in new if m["subject"].startswith(TEST_SUBJECT)]
    assert mail["to"] == settings.smtp_user != OWNER
    assert not any(OWNER in m["to"] for m in new)  # nothing at all reached the seller
    assert "got-it" not in mail["body"]  # no "Yes, I got it" link: a tap in our mailbox would prove nothing about hers
    with Session(engine) as s:
        t = s.exec(select(TestTicket).order_by(TestTicket.id.desc())).first()
        assert t.audience == "check" and t.confirm_hash == ""


def test_daily_proof_is_labelled_our_check_mailbox_and_the_chain_still_verifies(client, engine, integ, settings,
                                                                                 claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude).check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    got = last_result(engine, biz["id"], "monitor_")
    assert got["passed"] and got["mailbox"] == "check"
    assert "LaunchWitness's check mailbox" in got["plain"] and "your inbox" not in got["plain"]
    with Session(engine) as s:
        hops = [e.step for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.run_id == got["run_id"],
                                                              Evidence.check == "test_order")).all()]
        assert hops == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "imap_seen"]  # the same hops as ever
        seen = s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.run_id == got["run_id"], Evidence.step == "imap_seen")).one()
        assert seen.answer.startswith("LaunchWitness's check mailbox")
        assert chain.verify(s, biz["id"])["intact"]
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    check = next(c for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "test_order")
    assert check["title"] == "A test order reached LaunchWitness's check mailbox"
    assert any(h["title"] == "In LaunchWitness's check mailbox" for h in check["hops"])
    assert not any(h["title"] == "In the inbox" for h in check["hops"])


def test_launch_proof_still_says_your_inbox(client, engine, integ):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    check = next(c for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "test_order")
    assert check["title"] == "A test order reached your inbox" and check["mailbox"] == ""


def test_daily_test_missing_from_our_mailbox_is_our_side_and_never_alerts_her(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    mon = monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude)
    integ.mailer.drop = True  # accepted, never arrives
    mon.inbox_pass_seconds = 0
    mon.check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    (job,) = [j for j in mon.scheduler.get_jobs() if j.id.startswith("inbox-")]
    _b, run_id, item, _n = job.args
    assert mon.inbox_pass(biz["id"], run_id, item, 3) == "missing"
    got = last_result(engine, biz["id"], "monitor_daily")
    assert not got["passed"] and got["unfinished"] and "our side, not yours" in got["plain"]
    assert mon.recheck(biz["id"], ["test_order"]) == []  # couldn't check: no alert
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == biz["id"])).all() == []


# ---------- what it looks like ----------

def test_every_test_email_is_labelled_and_has_no_customer_buttons(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks")
    monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude).check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    sent = tests_sent(integ)
    assert len(sent) == 3
    with Session(engine) as s:
        nonces = [t.nonce for t in s.exec(select(TestTicket).order_by(TestTicket.id)).all()]
    for mail, nonce in zip(sent, nonces, strict=True):
        assert mail["subject"].startswith(f"{TEST_SUBJECT} ") and f"[{nonce}]" in mail["subject"]
        assert mail["body"].startswith(TEST_BANNER)
        assert "tel:" not in mail["body"] and "wa.me" not in mail["body"] and "WhatsApp the customer" not in mail["body"]
        assert "New order" not in mail["subject"] and "New order" not in mail["body"]
        assert 'data-lw="test-banner"' in mail["html"] and layout.TEST_BG in mail["html"]
        assert "tel:" not in mail["html"] and "wa.me" not in mail["html"]


def test_real_order_email_is_unchanged(client, engine, integ):
    launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST).status_code == 200
    mail = integ.mailer.sent[-1]
    assert mail["subject"].startswith("New order for Meera's Eggless Bakes from Asha Rao (LW-")
    assert not mail["subject"].startswith(TEST_SUBJECT) and "[" not in mail["subject"]
    assert mail["body"].startswith("New order LW-") and TEST_BANNER not in mail["body"]
    assert "Call: tel:+919876543210" in mail["body"] and "WhatsApp the customer: https://wa.me/" in mail["body"]
    assert "test-banner" not in mail["html"]


def test_banner_contrast_passes_aa():
    assert layout.contrast(layout.TEXT, layout.TEST_BG) >= 4.5


# ---------- test orders are evidence only ----------

def test_test_orders_hidden_from_orders_new_count_and_capacity(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email=OWNER)
    client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks")
    monitor(engine, settings, integ, claude).check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert len(s.exec(select(Order).where(Order.business_id == biz["id"], Order.is_test)).all()) == 3
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/orders").json() == []
    shop = next(b for b in client.get("/api/businesses").json() if b["id"] == biz["id"])
    assert shop["new_orders"] == 0
    from app.agents.reader import Profile
    from app.models import Business
    from app.sites.orders import full_days, orders_on

    with Session(engine) as s:
        b = s.get(Business, biz["id"])
        p = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json).model_copy(update={"max_orders_per_day": 1})

def headline(plan: Plan | None, latest_plan: Plan | None, run: dict | None,
             practice: bool = False) -> tuple[bool, str, list[str]]:
    if plan is None:
        if latest_plan is None:
            return False, "Your business isn't launched yet", ["Choose where your website lives and approve the launch."]
        if latest_plan.status in ("failed", "blocked"):
            msg = next((s["message"] for s in json.loads(latest_plan.steps_json) if s["status"] in ("failed", "blocked")),
                       "")
            return False, "Your launch stopped before the end", [msg or "Open the launch steps and press Resume."]
        return False, "Your launch is still running", ["We'll check everything as soon as it finishes."]
    if run is None or run["status"] == "running":
        return False, "Checking everything for you…", []
    left = [c["plain"] for c in run["checks"] if not c["passed"]]
    waiting = [c["plain"] for c in run["checks"] if c.get("state") == "needs_you"]
    if not left and run["passed"] and waiting:  # accepted is not delivered: only she can prove the last hop
        return False, "Almost ready: tell us the test order reached you", waiting
    if not left and run["passed"]:
        # Never an unlabelled "ready" from the pretend world.
        return True, PRACTICE_PASSED if practice else "Your business is ready for customers", []
    return False, "Almost there: a few things still need attention", left or ["We couldn't finish the checks."]


def public_resolvers_out(session: Session, business_id: int) -> dict | None:
    """S13b: the latest daily look through the public resolvers (stored evidence only)."""
    e = session.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id, Evidence.step == "public_resolvers")
                     .order_by(Evidence.id.desc())).first()
    if e is None:
        return None
    head, _sep, answers = e.answer.partition(" | ")
    m = re.match(r"Reachable from (\d+) of (\d+)", head)
    return {"at": iso(e.at), "title": head, "agree": bool(m and m.group(1) == m.group(2)), "answer": answers[:300],
            "practice": e.practice}


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/report")
def report(b: Annotated[Business, Depends(require_business_access)], actor: ActorDep,
           settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
           session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
           integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    admin = actor.is_admin
    practice = b.practice or integ_for(b).fake  # results from the pretend world are always labelled
    plan = latest_launched_plan(session, b.id)
    latest_plan = session.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == b.id, Plan.practice == b.practice)
                               .order_by(Plan.id.desc())).first()
    run_row = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.trigger.in_(OWNER_RUNS))
                           .order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
    run = run_out(session, run_row) if run_row and plan else None
    proven = proof.summary(session, run)  # adds each check's hops + state ("proven" / "needs_you" / "failed")
    ready, title, left = headline(plan, latest_plan, run, practice)

    def last(trigger: str) -> dict | None:
        r = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.trigger == trigger,
                                                CheckRun.status == "done").order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
        return {"at": iso(r.finished_at), "passed": r.passed} if r else None

    info_row = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.status == "done")
                            .order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
    info = json.loads(info_row.info_json) if info_row else {}
    events = session.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.business_id == b.id)
                          .order_by(AuditEvent.id.desc()).limit(AUDIT_LIMIT)).all()
    # A practice launch's own name is pretend (maybe someone else's real site): link the practice address instead.
    site = (f"https://{plan.site_host}/" if plan and plan.mode == "full" and not b.practice
            else site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b.subdomain else None)
    return {
        "business": {"id": b.id, "name": b.name, "site_url": site, "has_owner_email": bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)),
                     "practice": b.practice, "public": is_public(b) and not b.paused},
        "plan": {"id": plan.id, "mode": plan.mode, "site_host": plan.site_host, "mailbox": plan.mailbox}
        if plan else ({"id": latest_plan.id, "mode": latest_plan.mode, "site_host": latest_plan.site_host,
                       "mailbox": latest_plan.mailbox} if latest_plan else None),
        "practice": practice,
        "ready": ready, "headline": title, "left": left, "run": run, "proof": proven,
